```py
# Removes a */ that closes no comment from a frame definition file (.fdf).
def fixable(data_bytes):
    out = bytearray()
    removed = []
    i = 0
    n = len(data_bytes)
    status = 'normal'
    block_start = None
    while i < n:
        c = data_bytes[i:i + 1]
        d = data_bytes[i:i + 2]
        if status == 'normal':
            if d == b'//':
                status = 'ln'
                out += d
                i += 2
                continue
            if d == b'/*':
                status = 'block_entry'
                block_start = i
                out += d
                i += 2
                continue
            if d == b'*/':
                removed.append(i)
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == b'"':
                status = 'body_text'
            out += c
            i += 1
            continue
        if status == 'ln':
            if c in (b'\n', b'\r'):
                status = 'normal'
            out += c
            i += 1
            continue
        if status == 'block_entry':
            if d == b'*/':
                status = 'normal'
                out += d
                i += 2
                continue
            out += c
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == b'"' or c in (b'\n', b'\r'):
            status = 'normal'
        out += c
        i += 1
    unclosed = [block_start] if status == 'block_entry' else []
    return bytes(out), removed, unclosed


def fix_toc(data_bytes):
    if not data_bytes or data_bytes.endswith((b'\n', b'\r')):
        return data_bytes, False
    eol = b'\r\n' if b'\r\n' in data_bytes else (b'\n' if b'\n' in data_bytes else b'\r\n')
    return data_bytes + eol + eol, True
```

`doctor/fix/fdf_lint.py`:

```py
# Checks the frame files (.fdf, .toc) of a map for what makes the game skip a frame or a whole file.
import os
import re
import shutil



FRAME_TYPES = frozenset((
    'BACKDROP', 'BASE', 'BUTTON', 'CHATDISPLAY', 'CHECKBOX', 'CONTROL', 'DIALOG', 'EDITBOX', 'FRAME', 'GLUEBUTTON',
    'GLUECHECKBOX', 'GLUEEDITBOX', 'GLUEPOPUPMENU', 'GLUETEXTBUTTON', 'HIGHLIGHT', 'LISTBOX', 'LISTBOXITEM',
    'LISTBUTTON', 'MENU', 'MESSAGE', 'MODEL', 'POPUPMENU', 'RADIOGROUP', 'SCROLL', 'SCROLLBAR', 'SIMPLEBUTTON',
    'SIMPLECHECKBOX', 'SIMPLEFRAME', 'SIMPLEGRID', 'SIMPLEMESSAGEFRAME', 'SIMPLESTATUSBAR', 'SIMPLETOP',
    'SLASHCHATBOX', 'SLIDER', 'SPRITE', 'STATUSBAR', 'TEXT', 'TEXTAREA', 'TEXTBUTTON', 'TIMERTEXT'))
KEYWORDS = frozenset(k.lower() for k in (
    'Alpha AlphaMode Anchor Backdrop BackdropBackground BackdropBackgroundInsets BackdropBackgroundSize '
    'BackdropBlendAll BackdropBottomFile BackdropCornerFile BackdropCornerFlags BackdropCornerSize BackdropEdgeFile '
    'BackdropHalfSides BackdropLeftFile BackdropMirrored BackdropRightFile BackdropTileBackground BackdropTopFile '
    'BackgroundArt BarTexture ButtonPushedTextOffset ButtonText ChatDisplayBorderSize ChatDisplayEditBox '
    'ChatDisplayLineHeight ChatDisplayScrollBar CheckBoxCheckHighlight CheckBoxDisabledCheckHighlight Checked '
    'CheckedTexture ControlBackdrop ControlDisabledBackdrop ControlDisabledPushedBackdrop ControlFocusHighlight '
    'ControlMouseOverHighlight ControlPushedBackdrop ControlShortcutKey ControlStyle CursorSprite DecorateFileNames '
    'DialogBackdrop DialogCancelButton DialogOkButton DisabledText DisabledTexture DoNotRegisterName EditBorderSize '
    'EditCursorColor EditHighlightColor EditHighlightInitial EditMaxChars EditSetFocus EditText EditTextColor '
    'EditTextFrame EditTextHeight EditTextOffset File Font FontCharSpacing FontColor FontDisabledColor FontFlags '
    'FontHeight FontHighlightColor FontJustificationH FontJustificationOffset FontJustificationV FontShadowColor '
    'FontShadowOffset Frame FrameFont Height HighlightAlphaFile HighlightAlphaMode HighlightColor '
    'HighlightOutlineOffset HighlightText HighlightType ID IncludeFile Layer LayerStyle ListBoxBorder ListBoxItem '
    'ListBoxItemHeight ListBoxScrollBar ListBoxStyle MenuBorder MenuItem MenuItemHeight MenuTextHighlightColor '
    'NAMED NormalText NormalTexture PopupArrowFrame PopupButtonInset PopupMenuFrame PopupTitleFrame PushedTexture '
    'ScrollBarDecButtonFrame ScrollBarIncButtonFrame SetAllPoints SetPoint SliderInitialValue SliderLayoutHorizontal '
    'SliderLayoutVertical SliderMaxValue SliderMinValue SliderStepSize SliderThumbButtonFrame SpriteCamera '
    'SpriteScale StatusBarSprite String StringList TabFocusDefault TabFocusNext TabFocusPush TexCoord Text '
    'TextAreaInset TextAreaLineGap TextAreaLineHeight TextAreaMaxLines TextAreaScrollBar TextLength Texture ToolTip '
    'UseActiveContext UseBackdrop UseHighlight Width').split())
KEYWORDS |= frozenset(k.lower() for k in ''.split())
BLOCK_KEYWORDS = ('frame', 'string', 'texture', 'layer', 'stringlist')
RX_ACTION = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\Z')


def _finding(code, severity, file, line, text):
    return {'code': code, 'severity': severity, 'file': file, 'line': line, 'text': text}


def tokens(text):
    out = []
    i, n, line = 0, len(text), 1
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        if c == '\n':
            line += 1
            i += 1
            continue
        if c in ' \t\r﻿':
            i += 1
            continue
        d = text[i:i + 2]
        if d == '//':
            j = text.find('\n', i)
            i = n if j < 0 else j
            continue
        if d == '/*':
            j = text.find('*/', i + 2)
            end = n if j < 0 else j + 2
            line += text.count('\n', i, end)
            i = end
            continue
        if c == '"':
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and text[j] not in '"\r\n':
                j += 1
            closed = j < n and text[j] == '"'
            if not closed:
                k = text.find('"', j)
                if 0 <= k and text.count('\n', j, k) <= 3:
                    out.append(('str', text[i:k + 1], line))
                    line += text.count('\n', i, k)
                    i = k + 1
                    continue
            out.append(('str', text[i:j + (1 if closed else 0)], line))
            i = j + (1 if closed else 0)
            continue
        if c in '{},':
            out.append(('punct', c, line))
            i += 1
            continue
        j = i
        while j < n and text[j] not in ' \t\r\n{},"':
            j += 1
        out.append(('word', text[i:j], line))
        i = j
    return out


def is_action(word):
    return bool(RX_ACTION.match(word)) and word != word.upper()


def events(toks):
    ev = []
    cur = None
    expect = True
    for t in toks:
        kind, val = t[0], t[1]
        if kind == 'word' and expect and is_action(val):
            if cur is not None:
                ev.append(('action', cur[0], cur[1], True))
            cur = [t, []]
            expect = False
            continue
        if kind == 'punct':
            if val == ',':
                expect = True
            elif val == '{':
                ev.append(('open', cur[0] if cur else None, cur[1] if cur else []))
                cur = None
                expect = True
            else:
                if cur is not None:
                    ev.append(('action', cur[0], cur[1], False))
                    cur = None
                ev.append(('close', t[2]))
                expect = True
            continue
        if cur is None:
            continue
        if kind == 'word' and not expect and is_action(val) and val.lower() in KEYWORDS:
            ev.append(('action', cur[0], cur[1], False))
            ev.append(('missing', t))
            cur = [t, []]
            continue
        cur[1].append(t)
        expect = False
    if cur is not None:
        ev.append(('action', cur[0], cur[1], False))
    return ev


def _unq(tok):
    v = tok[1]
    return v[1:-1] if v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"') and len(v) >= 2 else v


def group(frame_type):
    return 'simple' if frame_type.startswith('SIMPLE') else 'frame'


def definitions(text):
    names, depth = set(), 0
    for e in events(tokens(text)):
        if e[0] == 'open':
            if depth == 0 and e[1] is not None and e[1][1].lower() in ('frame', 'string', 'texture'):
                a = [x for x in e[2] if x[0] == 'str']
                pick = a[1] if e[1][1].lower() == 'frame' and len(a) > 1 else (a[0] if a else None)
                if pick is not None:
                    names.add(_unq(pick).lower())
            depth += 1
        elif e[0] == 'close':
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
    return names


def _norm(path):
    return path.replace('/', '\\').lstrip('\\')


def lint_text(text, name='x.fdf', resolve=None, known=None):
    f = []
    mains = {}
    includes = []
    inherits = []
    stack = []
    for e in events(tokens(text)):
        if e[0] == 'close':
            if not stack:
                f.append(_finding('fdf_braces', 'warning', name, e[1], 'A `}` closes a block that was never opened.'))
            else:
                stack.pop()
            continue
        if e[0] == 'missing':
            if any(x[0] == 'stringlist' for x in stack):
                continue
            f.append(_finding('fdf_missing_comma', 'warning', name, e[1][2], 'The action %s starts where an argument '
                              'should be: the comma that ends the action before it is missing.' % e[1][1]))
            continue
        in_list = any(s[0] == 'stringlist' for s in stack)
        if e[0] == 'action':
            kw, args = e[1], e[2]
            key = kw[1].lower()
            if in_list:
                continue
            if key == 'includefile':
                strs = [a for a in args if a[0] == 'str']
                if strs:
                    includes.append((kw[2], _unq(strs[0])))
                continue
            if key not in KEYWORDS:
                f.append(_finding('fdf_keyword', 'info', name, kw[2], 'The action %s is not in the list of known fdf '
                                  'actions (a typo, or one the game knows and the list does not).' % kw[1]))
            continue
        kw, args = e[1], e[2]
        if kw is None:
            stack.append(('', None))
            continue
        key, line = kw[1].lower(), kw[2]
        strs = [a for a in args if a[0] == 'str']
        ftype = None
        if key == 'frame' and args:
            raw = args[0][1]
            if args[0][0] != 'str' or not raw.endswith('"') or len(raw) < 2:
                f.append(_finding('fdf_frame_type', 'warning', name, line,
                                  'The type of the frame (%s) is not written in quotes.' % raw))
            else:
                ftype = raw[1:-1]
                if ftype != ftype.upper():
                    f.append(_finding('fdf_frame_type', 'info', name, line, 'The frame type "%s" is not in '
                                      'capitals ("%s" is what the game\'s own files write).' % (ftype, ftype.upper())))
                    ftype = ftype.upper()
                if ftype not in FRAME_TYPES:
                    f.append(_finding('fdf_frame_type', 'warning', name, line,
                                      'The frame type "%s" is not one the game has.' % ftype))
            outer = next((s[1] for s in reversed(stack) if s[1]), None)
            if ftype and outer and group(ftype) == 'simple' and group(outer) == 'frame':
                f.append(_finding('fdf_hierarchy', 'warning', name, line, 'The simple frame "%s" is inside the frame '
                                  'type "%s": the two groups cannot be parent and child.' % (ftype, outer)))
        elif key not in BLOCK_KEYWORDS and not in_list:
            f.append(_finding('fdf_keyword', 'info', name, line, 'The action %s opens a block, which only Frame, '
                              'String, Texture, Layer and StringList do.' % kw[1]))
        if not stack and key in ('frame', 'string', 'texture'):
            mname = (_unq(strs[1]) if len(strs) > 1 else None) if key == 'frame' else (_unq(strs[0]) if strs else None)
            if mname is not None:
                k = mname.lower()
                if k in mains:
                    f.append(_finding('fdf_duplicate_mainframe', 'warning', name, line, 'Two frames named "%s" are '
                                      'defined in this file (the first at line %d): the game ignores the rest of the '
                                      'file from the second.' % (mname, mains[k])))
                else:
                    mains[k] = line
        if key in ('frame', 'string', 'texture'):
            for i, a in enumerate(args):
                if a[0] == 'word' and a[1].upper() == 'INHERITS':
                    rest = [x for x in args[i + 1:] if x[0] == 'str']
                    if rest:
                        inherits.append((line, _unq(rest[0])))
        stack.append((key, ftype))
    if stack:
        f.append(
            _finding('fdf_braces', 'warning', name, 0, '%d block(s) opened with `{` are never closed.' % len(stack))
        )
    if resolve is not None:
        for line, inc in includes:
            if resolve(_norm(inc)) is None:
                f.append(_finding('fdf_include_missing', 'warning', name, line,
                                  'IncludeFile "%s": neither the map nor the game has this file.' % inc))
    if known is not None:
        defined = set(mains)
        for line, parent in inherits:
            if parent.lower() not in defined and parent.lower() not in known:
                f.append(_finding('fdf_inherits_missing', 'warning', name, line,
                                  'INHERITS "%s": no FDF file of the map or of the game defines this frame.' % parent))
    return f


def lint_toc(data, name='x.toc', exists=None):
    f = []
    if data and not data.endswith((b'\n', b'\r')):
        f.append(_finding('toc_final_line', 'warning', name, data.count(b'\n') + 1,
                          'The TOC does not end with a line break: the game does not read its last line.'))
    if exists is not None:
        for i, ln in enumerate(data.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines(), 1):
            ln = ln.strip().lstrip('﻿')
            if ln and not ln.startswith('//') and not exists(_norm(ln)):
                f.append(_finding('toc_missing_file', 'warning', name, i,
                                  'The TOC names "%s", which neither the map nor the game has.' % ln))
    return f


def conserta_toc(data):
    from doctor.fix import fdf_fix
    return (getattr(fdf_fix, 'fix_toc', None) or getattr(fdf_fix, 'fix_toc'))(data)


def _ext(n, e):
    return n.lower().endswith(e)


_GAME_NAMES = []


def game_frame_names(g):
    for gg, names in _GAME_NAMES:
        if gg is g:
            return names
    names = set()
    for n in g.glob('.fdf'):
        d = g.read(n)
        if d:
            names |= definitions(d.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
    _GAME_NAMES.insert(0, (g, names))
    del _GAME_NAMES[2:]
    return names


def lint(path, progress=None, casc=None):
    p = progress or (lambda *_a, **_k: None)
    from doctor.fix import unprotect
    from doctor.models import model_check
    out = {'files': {}, 'counts': {}, 'fixable': 0, 'game': False, 'scanned': 0}
    a, err = model_check._open(path)
    if a is None:
        out['error'] = err
        return out
    p('Finding the file names')
    names = sorted((n for n in model_check._names(a) if _ext(n, '.fdf') or _ext(n, '.toc')), key=str.lower)
    if not names:
        return out
    from doctor.fix import game_paths
    g = game_paths.open_game(casc)
    out['game'] = g is not None
    cache = {}

    def resolve(pth):
        k = pth.lower()
        if k not in cache:
            d = unprotect._read(a, pth)
            if d is None and g is not None:
                d = g.read(pth)
                if d is None and g.has(pth):
                    d = b''
            cache[k] = d
        return cache[k]

    p('Checking the frame files')
    texts = {}
    known = None
    if g is not None:
        known = set(game_frame_names(g))
        for n in names:
            if _ext(n, '.fdf'):
                d = unprotect._read(a, n)
                if d is not None:
                    texts[n] = d.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
                    known |= definitions(texts[n])
    for n in names:
        d = unprotect._read(a, n)
        if d is None:
            continue
        out['scanned'] += 1
        if _ext(n, '.toc'):
            found = lint_toc(d, n, (lambda q: resolve(q) is not None) if g is not None else None)
        else:
            found = lint_text(
                texts.get(n) or d.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), n, resolve if g is not None else None, known
            )
        if found:
            out['files'][n] = found
            for x in found:
                out['counts'][x['code']] = out['counts'].get(x['code'], 0) + 1
                if x['code'] == 'toc_final_line':
                    out['fixable'] += 1
    return out


def fix(path_in, path_out, progress=None):
    p = progress or (lambda *_a, **_k: None)
    res = {'state': 'failed', 'fixed': 0, 'files': []}
    if os.path.abspath(path_in) == os.path.abspath(path_out):
        res['error'] = 'The output must be a new file.'
        return res
    from doctor.fix import unprotect
    from doctor.models import model_check
    from doctor.mpq import mpqadd
    p('Reading the map')
    a, err = model_check._open(path_in)
    if a is None:
        res['error'] = err
        return res
    names = model_check._names(a)
    repl = []
    for n in names:
        if not _ext(n, '.toc'):
            continue
        d = unprotect._read(a, n)
        if d is None:
            continue
        new, changed = conserta_toc(d)
        if changed:
            repl.append((n, new))
            res['files'].append({'file': n})
    if not repl:
        res['state'] = 'nothing_to_do'
        return res
    part = model_check._part(path_out)
    try:
        p('Writing the new map')
        shutil.copyfile(path_in, part)
        no_room = []
        with unprotect.quiet():
            mpqadd.add_files(part, repl, log=lambda *_a, **_k: None, no_slot=no_room)
        if no_room:
            raise RuntimeError('no room in the hash table for %s' % ', '.join(no_room))
        b, err = model_check._open(part)
        if b is None:
            raise RuntimeError(err)
        for n, new in repl:
            if unprotect._read(b, n) != new:
                raise RuntimeError('%s was not read back fixed' % n)
        done = set(n.lower() for n, _d in repl)
        for n in names:
            if n.lower() in done:
                continue
            x = unprotect._read(a, n)
            if x is not None and unprotect._read(b, n) != x:
                raise RuntimeError('%s changed' % n)
        del a, b
        os.replace(part, path_out)
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            os.remove(part)
        except OSError:
            pass
        res.update(error='The check of the new map failed (%s).' % (str(e) or type(e).__name__), fixed=0, files=[])
        return res
    res['state'] = 'done'
    res['fixed'] = len(repl)
    res['lines'] = ['%s: a final line break added, so the game reads the last line.' % f['file'] for f in res['files']]
    return res

```

`doctor/fix/game_builds.py`:

```py
# The builds of Warcraft III and the World Editor number each one writes.
import json
import os


HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

NAME = 'game_builds.json'
_TABLE = {}


def _roots():
    try:
        from doctor.data import wc3_versions
        return wc3_versions._ref_roots()
    except Exception:
        return [os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'ref'))]


def patch_label(patch):
    parts = str(patch or '').lstrip('vV').split('_')
    return '.'.join(parts)


def builds():
    if 'b' not in _TABLE:
        rows = []
        for root in _roots():
            p = os.path.join(root, NAME)
            if os.path.isfile(p):
                with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                cols = data.get('columns') or ['expansion', 'date', 'patch', 'version', 'editor']
                for r in data.get('builds') or []:
                    d = dict(zip(cols, r))
                    d['label'] = patch_label(d.get('patch'))
                    rows.append(d)
                break
        _TABLE['b'] = rows
    return list(_TABLE['b'])


def _game_version_text(game_version):
    if isinstance(game_version, str):
        return game_version.strip()
    try:
        return '.'.join(str(int(x)) for x in game_version)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ''


def by_version(game_version):
    want = _game_version_text(game_version)
    for b in builds():
        if b['version'] == want:
            return b
    return None


def by_editor(editor):
    try:
        n = int(editor)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return []
    return [b for b in builds() if b['editor'] == n]


def _years(rows):
    ys = sorted({b['date'][:4] for b in rows if b.get('date')})
    if not ys:
        return ''
    return ys[0] if len(ys) == 1 else '%s-%s' % (ys[0], ys[-1])


def describe(editor, game_version=None):
    rows = []
    exact = False
    if game_version:
        b = by_version(game_version)
        if b is not None:
            rows, exact = [b], True
    if not rows:
        rows = by_editor(editor)
    if not rows:
        return None
    first, last = rows[0]['label'], rows[-1]['label']
    years = _years(rows)
    if len(rows) == 1 or first == last:
        what = 'World Editor %s' % first
        if exact:
            what += ' (build %s)' % rows[0]['version']
    else:
        what = 'World Editor %s to %s' % (first, last)
    text = 'saved by %s%s' % (what, ' (%s)' % years if years else '')
    return {'text': text, 'first': first, 'last': last, 'exact': exact, 'builds': rows, 'years': years}


def describe_w3i(w3i_bytes):
    import struct
    if not w3i_bytes or len(w3i_bytes) < 12:
        return None
    fmt, _saves, editor = struct.unpack_from('<iii', w3i_bytes, 0)
    gv = None
    if fmt >= 27 and len(w3i_bytes) >= 28:
        gv = list(struct.unpack_from('<4i', w3i_bytes, 12))
    return describe(editor, gv)
```

`doctor/fix/game_paths.py`:

```py
# The paths of the installed game in every layer of its storage, for the checks that compare with it.
import re



RX_LAYER = re.compile(r'\Awar3\.w3mod:(?:(?:_locales\\)?[^\\:]+\.w3mod:)*')
_OPEN = []


def norm(path):
    return path.replace('/', '\\').lstrip('\\').lower()


class GameFiles(object):
    def __init__(self, casc):
        self.casc = casc
        self._by = {}
        for key in casc.file_set:
            m = RX_LAYER.match(key)
            short = key[m.end():] if m else key
            self._by.setdefault(short, []).append(key)

    def has(self, path):
        return norm(path) in self._by

    def names(self):
        return set(self._by)

    def _order(self, keys):
        def rank(k):
            if k.startswith('war3.w3mod:_hd.w3mod:'):
                return 1
            if '_locales\\enus.w3mod:' in k:
                return 2
            return 0 if k.count('.w3mod:') == 1 else 3
        return sorted(keys, key=rank)

    def read(self, path):
        for key in self._order(self._by.get(norm(path), ())):
            try:
                return self.casc.read_data(key)
            except Exception:
                continue
        return None

    def glob(self, ext):
        return sorted(n for n in self._by if n.endswith(ext))


def open_game(casc=None):
    if casc is None:
        try:
            from doctor.mpq import import_lint
            casc = import_lint.game_storage()
        except Exception:
            casc = None
    if casc is None:
        return None
    for c, g in _OPEN:
        if c is casc:
            return g
    g = GameFiles(casc)
    _OPEN.insert(0, (casc, g))
    del _OPEN[2:]
    return g
```

`doctor/fix/handle_nulls.py`:

```py
# Finds the handle locals a JASS function leaves without null, and writes the missing lines.
import os
import re

from doctor.script import jass_ast


REF_30 = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', 'ref', '3.0'))
COUNTED_ALTHOUGH_HANDLE = ('triggeraction', 'unitpool', 'itempool', 'camerasetup', 'framehandle', 'commandbuttoneffect')
FALLBACK = frozenset(
    (
        'agent',
        'event',
        'player',
        'widget',
        'unit',
        'destructable',
        'item',
        'ability',
        'buff',
        'force',
        'group',
        'trigger',
        'triggercondition',
        'timer',
        'location',
        'region',
        'rect',
        'boolexpr',
        'sound',
        'conditionfunc',
        'filterfunc',
        'effect',
        'fogmodifier',
        'dialog',
        'button',
        'quest',
        'questitem',
        'defeatcondition',
        'timerdialog',
        'leaderboard',
        'multiboard',
        'multiboarditem',
        'trackable',
        'gamecache',
        'hashtable',
        'framehandle',
    )
    + COUNTED_ALTHOUGH_HANDLE
)
RX_TYPE = re.compile(r'^[ \t]*type[ \t]+(\w+)[ \t]+extends[ \t]+(\w+)', re.M)
_TYPES = {}
LIST_MAX = 60
NULL, NONNULL, MAYBE = 'N', 'X', 'M'


def _common_text():
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(REF_30, 'common.j'), 'rb') as fh:
            return fh.read().decode('latin-1')
    except OSError:
        return None


def types(common_text=None, script_text=None):
    key = (common_text is None, hash(common_text) if common_text else 0, hash(script_text) if script_text else 0)
    if key in _TYPES:
        return _TYPES[key]
    parent = {}
    text = common_text if common_text is not None else _common_text()
    for t in (text, script_text):
        if t:
            for m in RX_TYPE.finditer(t):
                parent.setdefault(m.group(1), m.group(2))
    if not parent:
        out = FALLBACK
    else:
        out = set(COUNTED_ALTHOUGH_HANDLE)
        for name in parent:
            seen, n = set(), name
            while n in parent and n not in seen:
                seen.add(n)
                n = parent[n]
                if n == 'agent':
                    out.add(name)
                    break
        out.add('agent')
        out = frozenset(out)
    if len(_TYPES) > 8:
        _TYPES.clear()
    _TYPES[key] = out
    return out


def _is_null(e):
    return type(e) is jass_ast.Literal and e.kind == 'null' or type(e) is jass_ast.Name and e.name == 'null'


def _unparen(e):
    while type(e) is jass_ast.Paren:
        e = e.inner
    return e


def _guard(cond, tracked):
    cond = _unparen(cond)
    if type(cond) is jass_ast.Unary and cond.op == 'not':
        g = _guard(cond.operand, tracked)
        return None if g is None else (g[0], not g[1])
    if type(cond) is jass_ast.Binary and cond.op in ('==', '!='):
        a, b = _unparen(cond.left), _unparen(cond.right)
        if _is_null(b) and type(a) is jass_ast.Name and a.name in tracked:
            return a.name, cond.op == '=='
        if _is_null(a) and type(b) is jass_ast.Name and b.name in tracked:
            return b.name, cond.op == '=='
    return None


def _refine(state, cond, truth, tracked):
    g = _guard(cond, tracked)
    if g is None:
        return state
    name, is_null = g
    out = dict(state)
    out[name] = NULL if is_null == truth else NONNULL
    return out


def _join(a, b):
    out = dict(a)
    for k, v in b.items():
        w = a.get(k, NULL)
        out[k] = w if w == v else MAYBE
    return out


def _join_all(states):
    out = None
    for s in states:
        out = s if out is None else _join(out, s)
    return out


class _Flow(object):
    def __init__(self, tracked):
        self.tracked = tracked
        self.exits = []

    def block(self, stmts, state, loops, record):
        for s in stmts:
            t = type(s)
            if t is jass_ast.SetStmt:
                if type(s.target) is jass_ast.Name and s.target.name in self.tracked:
                    state = dict(state)
                    state[s.target.name] = NULL if _is_null(s.value) else NONNULL
            elif t is jass_ast.ReturnStmt:
                if record:
                    self.exits.append(('return', s.line, s, state))
                return None
            elif t is jass_ast.IfStmt:
                state = self.branches(s, state, loops, record)
                if state is None:
                    return None
            elif t is jass_ast.LoopStmt:
                state = self.loop(s, state, loops, record)
                if state is None:
                    return None
            elif t is jass_ast.ExitWhenStmt:
                if loops:
                    loops[-1].append(_refine(state, s.cond, True, self.tracked))
                state = _refine(state, s.cond, False, self.tracked)
            elif t is jass_ast.DebugStmt:
                inner = s.stmt
                if type(inner) is jass_ast.SetStmt or type(inner) is jass_ast.CallStmt:
                    after = self.block([inner], state, loops, False)
                    state = _join(state, after) if after is not None else state
        return state

    def branches(self, s, state, loops, record):
        cur = state
        results = []
        has_else = False
        for cond, body in s.branches:
            if cond is None:
                has_else = True
                bstate = cur
            else:
                bstate = _refine(cur, cond, True, self.tracked)
            end = self.block(body, bstate, loops, record)
            if end is not None:
                results.append(end)
            if cond is not None:
                cur = _refine(cur, cond, False, self.tracked)
        if not has_else:
            results.append(cur)
        return _join_all(results)

    def loop(self, s, state, loops, record):
        exits = []
        if not record:
            self.block(s.body, state, loops + [exits], False)
            return _join_all(exits)
        end = self.block(s.body, state, loops + [exits], False)
        start = state if end is None else _join(state, end)
        exits = []
        end = self.block(s.body, start, loops + [exits], record)
        return _join_all(exits)


def _locals_of(f, ntypes):
    out, lines = {}, {}
    for d in f.locals:
        if not d.is_array and d.type in ntypes:
            out[d.name] = d.type
            lines[d.name] = d.line
    return out, lines


def _initial(f, tracked):
    state = {}
    for d in f.locals:
        if d.name in tracked:
            state[d.name] = NULL if d.initializer is None or _is_null(d.initializer) else NONNULL
    return state


def _reads(e):
    return set(n.name for n in jass_ast.walk(e) if type(n) is jass_ast.Name)


def function_leaks(f, ntypes):
    tracked, decl = _locals_of(f, ntypes)
    if not tracked:
        return []
    flow = _Flow(tracked)
    end = flow.block(f.body, _initial(f, tracked), [], True)
    if end is not None:
        flow.exits.append(('end', f.end_line, None, end))
    out = []
    for kind, line, stmt, state in flow.exits:
        reads = _reads(stmt.value) if stmt is not None and stmt.value is not None else ()
        for name, st in state.items():
            if st != NULL:
                out.append({'local': name, 'type': tracked[name], 'kind': kind, 'line': line,
                            'decl_line': decl[name], 'returned': name in reads, 'stmt': stmt})
    return out


def analyze(text_or_tree, types_=None, heat=True, common_text=None):
    if isinstance(text_or_tree, jass_ast.Script):
        tree, text = text_or_tree, None
    else:
        text = text_or_tree
        try:
            tree = jass_ast.parse(text)
        except jass_ast.JassSyntaxError as e:
            return {'language': 'jass', 'error': 'The script does not parse (%s).' % e}
    ntypes = types_ or types(common_text, text)
    heats = {}
    if heat:
        try:
            from doctor.script import script_checks
            heats = script_checks.heat_of(tree)
        except Exception:
            heats = {}
    leaks, n_locals, n_funcs = [], 0, 0
    for f in tree.functions:
        tracked, _decl = _locals_of(f, ntypes)
        if not tracked:
            continue
        n_locals += len(tracked)
        found = function_leaks(f, ntypes)
        if found:
            n_funcs += 1
        for x in found:
            x.pop('stmt', None)
            x['function'] = f.name
            x['heat'] = heats.get(f.name)
            leaks.append(x)
    counts = {'leaks': len(leaks), 'locals': n_locals, 'functions': n_funcs,
              'locals_leaking': len(set((x['function'], x['local']) for x in leaks))}
    for h in ('hot', 'repeat', 'once', 'unused'):
        counts[h] = len(set((x['function'], x['local']) for x in leaks if x['heat'] == h))
    order = {'hot': 0, 'repeat': 1, 'once': 2, 'unused': 3, None: 4}
    leaks.sort(key=lambda x: (order[x['heat']], x['line']))
    out = {'language': 'jass', 'leaks': leaks[:LIST_MAX * 5], 'counts': counts}
    out['lines'] = summary(out)
    return out


def summary(r):
    if r.get('error'):
        return [r['error']]
    c = r['counts']
    if not c['leaks']:
        return ['No handle local is left set when its function ends.']
    out = ['%d handle locals in %d functions are not set to null when the function ends (%d on a periodic timer, %d on '
           'an event): each keeps its object\'s handle id from being recycled.' % (
               c['locals_leaking'], c['functions'], c['hot'], c['repeat'])]
    seen = set()
    for x in r['leaks']:
        k = (x['function'], x['local'])
        if k in seen or x['heat'] not in ('hot', 'repeat'):
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append('  line %d, %s: local %s (%s).' % (x['line'], x['function'], x['local'], x['type']))
        if len(seen) >= 8:
            break
    return out


def reforged_items(r, item=None):
    if r.get('error') or not r.get('counts') or not r['counts']['leaks']:
        return []
    c = r['counts']
    text = ('%d handle locals in %d functions are not set to null when the function ends (%d on a periodic timer, '
            '%d on an event): each keeps its object\'s handle id from being recycled. The Fix map option "Null handle '
            'locals" writes the missing lines.' % (c['locals_leaking'], c['functions'], c['hot'], c['repeat']))
    make = item or (lambda code, sev, text_, fix, **data: dict(code=code, severity=sev, text=text_, fix=fix, data=data))
    return [make('handle_locals_not_nulled', 'info', text, 'doctor', locals=c['locals_leaking'],
                 functions=c['functions'], hot=c['hot'], repeat=c['repeat'])]


_LINE_RE = re.compile(r'[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\r|\n|\Z)')


def _split(text):
    out = _LINE_RE.findall(text)
    if out and out[-1] == '':
        out.pop()
    return out


def _eol(text):
    m = re.search(r'\r\n|\r|\n', text)
    return m.group(0) if m else '\n'


def _indent(line):
    return line[:len(line) - len(line.lstrip(' \t'))]


def _body_indent(f, lines):
    for node in list(f.locals) + list(f.body):
        n = getattr(node, 'line', 0)
        if 0 < n <= len(lines) and lines[n - 1].strip() and not lines[n - 1].lstrip().startswith('function'):
            return _indent(lines[n - 1])
    return '    '


def _free_name(text, base):
    name, k = base, 0
    while re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\b', text):
        k += 1
        name = '%s_%d' % (base, k)
    return name


def fix_text(text, types_=None, common_text=None):
    rep = {'state': 'nothing_to_do', 'reason': None, 'nulls': 0, 'functions': 0, 'temps': [], 'skipped': 0}
    try:
        tree = jass_ast.parse(text)
    except jass_ast.JassSyntaxError as e:
        rep.update(state='failed', reason='The script does not parse (%s).' % e)
        return text, rep
    ntypes = types_ or types(common_text, text)
    lines = _split(text)
    eol = _eol(text)
    before, after = {}, {}
    temps = {}
    changed = set()

    def temp(rtype):
        if rtype not in temps:
            temps[rtype] = _free_name(text, 'nl__' + rtype)
        return temps[rtype]

    for f in tree.functions:
        tracked, _decl = _locals_of(f, ntypes)
        if not tracked:
            continue
        found = function_leaks(f, ntypes)
        if not found:
            continue
        by_exit = {}
        for x in found:
            by_exit.setdefault((x['kind'], x['line']), []).append(x)
        for (kind, line), xs in sorted(by_exit.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0][1]):
            if line < 1 or line > len(lines):
                rep['skipped'] += len(xs)
                continue
            src = lines[line - 1]
            ind = _indent(src)
            names = sorted(set(x['local'] for x in xs), key=lambda n: [d.name for d in f.locals].index(n))
            nulls = [ind + 'set ' + n + ' = null' for n in names]
            if kind == 'end':
                if src.strip().split('//')[0].strip() != 'endfunction':
                    rep['skipped'] += len(xs)
                    continue
                ind = _body_indent(f, lines)
                before.setdefault(line, []).extend(ind + 'set ' + n + ' = null' for n in names)
                rep['nulls'] += len(names)
                changed.add(f.name)
                continue
            head = src.strip()
            if not head.startswith('return') or (len(head) > 6 and head[6] not in ' \t/('):
                rep['skipped'] += len(xs)
                continue
            stmt = xs[0].get('stmt')
            if any(x['returned'] for x in xs) or (stmt is not None and stmt.value is not None and
                                                  _reads(stmt.value) & set(names)):
                if f.return_type in ('nothing',):
                    rep['skipped'] += len(xs)
                    continue
                g = temp(f.return_type)
                comment = ('' if not stmt.comment else ' ' + stmt.comment)
                after[line] = ([ind + 'set ' + g + ' = ' + jass_ast._ue(stmt.value)] + nulls +
                               [ind + 'return ' + g + comment])
            else:
                before.setdefault(line, []).extend(nulls)
            rep['nulls'] += len(names)
            changed.add(f.name)
    if not rep['nulls']:
        if rep['skipped']:
            rep['reason'] = '%d exits could not be edited by line.' % rep['skipped']
        return text, rep
    if temps:
        decls = [ind_ + t + ' ' + g for t, g in sorted(temps.items()) for ind_ in ['    ']]
        end_globals = next((i + 1 for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip().split('//')[0].strip() == 'endglobals'),
                           None)
        if end_globals is not None:
            before.setdefault(end_globals, [])
            before[end_globals] = decls + before[end_globals]
        else:
            first = next((i + 1 for i, ln in enumerate(lines)
                          if re.match(r'[ \t]*(?:constant[ \t]+)?function[ \t]', ln)), None)
            if first is None:
                rep.update(state='failed', reason='There is no place for the global the returns go through.')
                return text, rep
            before.setdefault(first, [])
            before[first] = ['globals'] + decls + ['endglobals'] + before[first]
    out = []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
        for extra in before.get(i, ()):
            out.append(extra + eol)
        if i in after:
            tail = re.search(r'(?:\r\n|\r|\n)\Z', ln)
            repl = after[i]
            out.append(eol.join(repl) + (tail.group(0) if tail else ''))
        else:
            out.append(ln)
    new = ''.join(out)
    try:
        jass_ast.parse(new)
    except jass_ast.JassSyntaxError as e:
        rep.update(state='failed', reason='The fixed script does not parse (%s): kept as it was.' % e)
        return text, rep
    rep.update(state='done', functions=len(changed), temps=sorted(temps.values()))
    return new, rep


def _pjass(text, common=None, blizzard=None, pjass=None, workdir=None):
    import tempfile
    from doctor.script import pjass as pj
    ref = pj.REF_30
    tmp = workdir or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='handle_nulls_')
    os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(tmp, 'war3map.j')
    try:
        with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(text.encode('latin-1') if isinstance(text, str) else text)
        res = pj.run_action([(common or os.path.join(ref, 'common.j'), 'common.j'),
                             (blizzard or os.path.join(ref, 'blizzard.j'), 'blizzard.j'), (path, 'war3map.j')],
                            pjass=pjass, tmp=tmp)
    finally:
        if workdir is None:
            import shutil
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    return res


def prove(before, after, pjass=None, workdir=None, run_main=True, budget=400000, seconds=15.0):
    out = {'ok': True, 'pjass': {}, 'eval': {}}
    a = _pjass(before, pjass=pjass, workdir=workdir and os.path.join(workdir, 'a'))
    b = _pjass(after, pjass=pjass, workdir=workdir and os.path.join(workdir, 'b'))
    na, nb = len(a['error_list']) + len(a['warnings']), len(b['error_list']) + len(b['warnings'])
    out['pjass'] = {'before': na, 'after': nb, 'rc_before': a['rc'], 'rc_after': b['rc'],
                    'first_errors': (b['error_list'] or b['warnings'])[:5]}
    if nb > na or (a['rc'] == 0 and b['rc'] != 0):
        out['ok'] = False
    if run_main:
        from doctor.script import jass_eval
        data_a = before.encode('latin-1') if isinstance(before, str) else before
        data_b = after.encode('latin-1') if isinstance(after, str) else after
        ia = jass_eval.run(data_a, budget=budget, seconds=seconds)
        ib = jass_eval.run(data_b, budget=budget, seconds=seconds)

        def plain(it):
            return dict((k, v) for k, v in it.globals.items()
                        if isinstance(v, (int, float, bool, str)) and not isinstance(v, jass_eval.Handle))
        same_unknown = ia.unknown == ib.unknown
        same_crashes = ia.crashes == ib.crashes
        pa, pb = plain(ia), plain(ib)
        extra = [k for k in pb if k not in pa and k.startswith('nl__')]
        same_globals = all(pa.get(k) == pb.get(k) for k in pa)
        out['eval'] = {'unknown_same': same_unknown, 'crashes_same': same_crashes, 'globals_same': same_globals,
                       'globals': len(pa), 'stopped_before': ia.stopped, 'stopped_after': ib.stopped,
                       'steps_before': ia.steps, 'steps_after': ib.steps, 'temps_seen': len(extra)}
        if not (same_unknown and same_crashes and same_globals) or (ia.stopped is None) != (ib.stopped is None):
            out['ok'] = False
    return out


def fix(path_in, path_out, progress=None):
    from doctor.fix import script_rewrite

    def transform(text, language):
        if language != 'jass':
            return text, {'state': 'nothing_to_do', 'reason': 'The script is %s, not JASS.' % language}
        new, rep = fix_text(text)
        if rep['state'] == 'done':
            pj = prove(text, new, run_main=False)
            rep['pjass'] = pj['pjass']
            if not pj['ok']:
                return text, {
                    'state': 'refused',
                    'reason': 'pjass finds more errors in the fixed script: kept as it was.',
                    'nulls': 0,
                }
        return new, rep

    def line(name, r):
        return '%s: %d "set x = null" lines written in %d functions%s.' % (
            name, r['nulls'], r['functions'], (', %d exits left as they are' % r['skipped']) if r['skipped'] else '')
    return script_rewrite.rewrite(path_in, path_out, transform, progress, line)


def check(path):
    if path.lower().endswith(('.j', '.ai')):
        return analyze(jass_ast.read_script(path))
    from doctor.fix import single_player
    try:
        _a, sc, _s = single_player.read_map(path)
    except BaseException as e:
        if isinstance(e, KeyboardInterrupt):
            raise
        return {'error': 'The map cannot be read (%s).' % e, 'lines': ['The map cannot be read.']}
    if sc['bytes'] is None or sc['language'] != 'jass':
        return {'error': 'The map has no JASS script.', 'lines': ['The map has no JASS script.']}
    return analyze(sc['bytes'].decode('latin-1'))
```

```py
# Finds and fixes inflated record counters in the files only the World Editor reads.
import os
import re
import struct



DOES_NOT_FIT = 'does_not_fit'
SHORT_READ = 'short_read'
EMPTY = 'empty'
ODD_VERSION = 'odd_version'

FILES = ('war3map.w3r', 'war3map.w3c', 'war3map.w3s', 'war3mapUnits.doo', 'war3map.wtg', 'war3map.wct',
         'war3map.imp', 'war3map.mmp')
REPORTED_ONLY = ('war3map.doo', 'war3map.w3e', 'war3map.w3i')
NO_REWRITE = ('war3map.wtg', 'war3mapUnits.doo')


class End(Exception):
    pass


class FormatError(Exception):
    pass


_I32 = struct.Struct('<i').unpack_from
_U32 = struct.Struct('<I').unpack_from
_F32 = struct.Struct('<f').unpack_from


class Reader(object):
    __slots__ = ('b', 'o')

    def __init__(self, b, o=0):
        self.b, self.o = b, o

    def remaining(self):
        return len(self.b) - self.o

    def _require(self, n):
        if n < 0:
            raise End('negative length (%d)' % n)
        if self.remaining() < n:
            raise End('%d B missing' % (n - self.remaining()))

    def i32(self):
        o = self.o
        if len(self.b) - o < 4:
            self._require(4)
        v = _I32(self.b, o)[0]
        self.o = o + 4
        return v

    def u32(self):
        o = self.o
        if len(self.b) - o < 4:
            self._require(4)
        v = _U32(self.b, o)[0]
        self.o = o + 4
        return v

    def f32(self):
        o = self.o
        if len(self.b) - o < 4:
            self._require(4)
        v = _F32(self.b, o)[0]
        self.o = o + 4
        return v

    def f32s(self, n):
        o = self.o
        if len(self.b) - o >= 4 * n:
            v = list(struct.unpack_from('<%df' % n, self.b, o))
            self.o = o + 4 * n
            return v
        return [self.f32() for _ in range(n)]

    def bs(self, n):
        o = self.o
        if n < 0 or len(self.b) - o < n:
            self._require(n)
        v = self.b[o:o + n]
        self.o = o + n
        return v

    def s(self, cap=4096):
        e = self.b.find(b'\x00', self.o)
        if e < 0 or e - self.o > cap:
            raise End('string without NUL (or longer than %d B)' % cap)
        v = self.b[self.o:e]
        self.o = e + 1
        return v


def ascii_mark(v):
    b = struct.pack('<I', v & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return b.decode('ascii') if all(32 <= c < 127 for c in b) else None


def _res(regs, declared, r, minimum, header, count_pos, **extra):
    d = {
        'regs': regs,
        'declared': declared,
        'remaining': r.remaining(),
        'end_pos': r.o,
        'minimum': minimum,
        'header': header,
        'count_pos': count_pos,
        'available': len(r.b) - header,
    }
    d.update(extra)
    return d


def min_w3r(v):
    n = 16 + 1
    n += 4 if v >= 1 else 0
    n += 4 if v >= 3 else 0
    n += 1 if v >= 4 else 0
    n += 4 if v >= 5 else 0
    n += 8 if v >= 7 else 0
    return n


def read_region(r, v):
    reg = {}
    if v >= 2:
        reg['rect'] = r.f32s(4)
    else:
        reg['rect'] = [float(r.i32()) for _ in range(4)]
    reg['fname'] = r.s()
    if v >= 1:
        reg['creation'] = r.i32()
    if v >= 3:
        reg['weather'] = r.bs(4)
    if v >= 4:
        reg['sound'] = r.s()
    if v >= 5:
        reg['color'] = r.bs(4)
    if v >= 7:
        r.i32()
        r.i32()
    return reg


def read_w3r(b):
    r = Reader(b, 8)
    v, n = struct.unpack_from('<II', b, 0)
    regs = []
    for _ in range(min(n, 1 << 20)):
        try:
            regs.append(read_region(r, v))
        except End:
            break
    return _res(regs, n, r, min_w3r(v), 8, 4, version_num=v)


RX_BLOCKER = re.compile(r'\bAddCameraBlocker\s*\(\s*(\w+)\s*\)')


def write_w3r(regions, v=None):
    if v is None:
        v = 7 if any(x.get('block_reason') for x in regions) else 5
    out = [struct.pack('<ii', v, len(regions))]
    for x in regions:
        out.append(struct.pack('<4f', *[float(c) for c in x['rect']]))
        fname = x.get('fname') or ''
        out.append((fname.encode('utf-8', 'replace') if isinstance(fname, str) else fname) + b'\x00')
        out.append(struct.pack('<i', int(x.get('creation', 0))))
        out.append(x.get('weather') or b'\x00' * 4)
        sound = x.get('sound') or b''
        out.append((sound.encode('utf-8', 'replace') if isinstance(sound, str) else sound) + b'\x00')
        out.append(x.get('color') or bytes((0xFF, 0x80, 0x80, 0xFF)))
        if v >= 7:
            out.append(struct.pack('<ii', *((1, 1) if x.get('block_reason') else (0, 0))))
    return b''.join(out)


def w3r_without_outside_sounds(b, b_w3s):
    d = read_w3r(b)
    if d.get('version_num') != 5 or d['remaining'] != 0:
        return b, []
    sounds = set()
    if b_w3s:
        try:
            from doctor.triggers import editor_render
            sounds = set(s['name'] for s in editor_render.read_w3s(b_w3s)[1])
        except Exception:
            sounds = set()
    removed = [r['sound'].decode('latin-1') for r in d['regs'] if r.get('sound') and r['sound'] not in sounds]
    if not removed:
        return b, []
    for r in d['regs']:
        if r.get('sound') and r['sound'] not in sounds:
            r['sound'] = b''
    return write_w3r(d['regs'], 5), removed


def min_w3c(v, new_ones=True, dof=None):
    if dof is None:
        return min(min_w3c(v, new_ones, True), min_w3c(v, new_ones, False))
    n = 10 * 4 + 1
    n += 12 if new_ones else 0
    n += (12 + 4) if (dof and v >= 3) else 0
    return n


def read_camera(r, v, new_ones, dof=True):
    k = 10 + (3 if new_ones else 0) + (3 if (dof and v >= 3) else 0)
    if r.remaining() >= 4 * k:
        f = r.f32s(k)
        cpath = {'tgt': f[0:2], 'z': f[2], 'rotation': f[3], 'angle': f[4], 'target_distance': f[5], 'roll': f[6],
                 'fov': f[7], 'far': f[8], 'near': f[9]}
        if new_ones:
            cpath['local'] = f[10:13]
        if dof and v >= 3:
            cpath['dof'] = f[k - 3:k]
    else:
        cpath = {'tgt': [r.f32() for _ in range(2)], 'z': r.f32(), 'rotation': r.f32(), 'angle': r.f32(),
                 'target_distance': r.f32(), 'roll': r.f32(), 'fov': r.f32(), 'far': r.f32(), 'near': r.f32()}
        if new_ones:
            cpath['local'] = [r.f32() for _ in range(3)]
        if dof and v >= 3:
            cpath['dof'] = [r.f32() for _ in range(3)]
    cpath['fname'] = r.s()
    if dof and v >= 3:
        cpath['kind'] = r.i32()
    return cpath


def read_w3c(b):
    v, n = struct.unpack_from('<II', b, 0)
    best = None
    for new_ones in (False, True):
        for dof in (False, True):
            if dof and v < 3:
                continue
            r = Reader(b, 8)
            regs = []
            for _ in range(min(n, 1 << 20)):
                try:
                    regs.append(read_camera(r, v, new_ones, dof))
                except End:
                    break
            cand = _res(regs, n, r, min_w3c(v, new_ones, dof), 8, 4, version_num=v, layout=(new_ones, dof))
            if r.remaining() == 0 and len(regs) == n:
                return cand
            if best is None or (0 <= cand['remaining'] < best['remaining']):
                best = cand
    return best


def write_w3c(cameras, version_num=0, new_ones=False, dof=False):
    out = [struct.pack('<ii', version_num, len(cameras))]
    for c in cameras:
        out.append(struct.pack('<10f', c['tgt'][0], c['tgt'][1], c.get('z', 0.0), c.get('rotation', 0.0),
                               c.get('angle', 0.0), c.get('target_distance', 0.0), c.get('roll', 0.0),
                               c.get('fov', 0.0), c.get('far', 0.0), c.get('near', 100.0)))
        if new_ones:
            out.append(struct.pack('<3f', *(c.get('local') or [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])))
        if dof and version_num >= 3:
            out.append(struct.pack('<3f', *(c.get('dof') or [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])))
        fname = c.get('fname') or b''
        out.append((fname.encode('utf-8', 'replace') if isinstance(fname, str) else fname) + b'\x00')
        if dof and version_num >= 3:
            out.append(struct.pack('<i', int(c.get('kind', 0))))
    return b''.join(out)

def read_sound(r, v):
    sound = {'fname': r.s(SOUND_CAP), 'file_path': r.s(SOUND_CAP), 'eax': r.s(SOUND_CAP), 'flags': r.i32()}
    for _c in range(3):

    r.f32()
    r.i32()
    r.i32()

def read_w3s_records(b):

RX_SOUND_CREATE = re.compile(r'(?:\bset\s+)?\b(gg_snd_\w+)\s*=\s*CreateSound\s*\(')
RX_SOUND_MUSIC = re.compile(r'(?:\bset\s+)?\b(gg_snd_\w+)\s*=\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")')

SOUND_UNSET = 4294967296.0


def _jass_args(body_text, begin):
    args, cur, max_depth, i = [], [], 0, begin + 1
    while i < len(body_text):
        c = body_text[i]
        if c == '"':
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(body_text) and body_text[j] != '"':
                j += 2 if body_text[j] == '\\' else 1
            cur.append(body_text[i:j + 1])
            i = j + 1
            continue
        if c == '(':
            max_depth += 1
        elif c == ')':
            if max_depth == 0:
                args.append(''.join(cur).strip())
                return args, i + 1
            max_depth -= 1
        elif c == ',' and max_depth == 0:
            args.append(''.join(cur).strip())
            cur = []
            i += 1
            continue
        cur.append(c)
        i += 1
    return None, len(body_text)


def _jass_string(t):
    t = t.strip()
    if len(t) < 2 or t[0] != '"' or t[-1] != '"':
        raise ValueError(t)
    out, i, s = [], 0, t[1:-1]
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i] == '\\' and i + 1 < len(s):
            out.append({'n': '\n', 't': '\t', 'r': '\r'}.get(s[i + 1], s[i + 1]))
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    try:
        return ''.join(out).encode('latin-1')
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        return ''.join(out).encode('utf-8', 'surrogateescape')
```
