```j
function KKP_taxa_txt takes integer tipo,integer taxa,integer pid returns string
    local real m=KKP_mult[pid]
    if tipo==0 or (taxa>=1000 and tipo!=3) then
        return "|cff00ff00always|r"
    elseif tipo==3 or taxa<0 then
        return "|cff999999rolled by the boss|r"
    endif
    if m<=0.0 then
        set m=1.0
    endif
    if I2R(taxa)*m>=1000.0 then
        return "|cff00ff00always|r"
    endif
    return "|cff00ff00"+KKP_pct(I2R(taxa)*m/10.0)+"|r"
endfunction

function KKP_pagina takes integer top,integer por,integer n returns string
    local integer tot=(n+por-1)/por
    local integer pg=top/por+1
    if tot<1 then
        set tot=1
    endif
    if top+por>=n or pg>tot then
        set pg=tot
    endif
    return "Page "+I2S(pg)+"/"+I2S(tot)
endfunction

function KKP_tg takes integer qual returns trigger
    if qual==1 then
        return KKP_t_g1
    elseif qual==2 then
        return KKP_t_g2
    elseif qual==3 then
        return KKP_t_g3
    elseif qual==4 then
        return KKP_t_g4
    elseif qual==5 then
        return KKP_t_g5
    elseif qual==6 then
        return KKP_t_g6
    elseif qual==7 then
        return KKP_t_g7
    endif
    return KKP_t_g8
endfunction

function KKP_gancho takes integer qual,code f returns nothing
    if qual<1 or qual>8 then
        return
    endif
    call TriggerAddCondition(KKP_tg(qual), Condition(f))
    set KKP_g_tem[qual]=true
endfunction

function KKP_chama takes integer qual returns boolean
    if qual<1 or qual>8 or not KKP_g_tem[qual] then
        return false
    endif
    call TriggerEvaluate(KKP_tg(qual))
    return true
endfunction

function KKP_amostra takes integer pid returns nothing
    local unit h
    set KKP_arg_pid=pid
    call KKP_chama(KKP_G_FICHA)
    set h=KKP_heroi[pid]
    if h==null or GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 then
        set KKP_h_ok[pid]=false
        set h=null
        return
    endif
    set KKP_h_ok[pid]=true
    set KKP_h_tipo[pid]=GetUnitTypeId(h)
    set KKP_h_nome[pid]=GetUnitName(h)
    set KKP_h_nivel[pid]=GetHeroLevel(h)
    set KKP_h_for[pid]=GetHeroStr(h, false)
    set KKP_h_agi[pid]=GetHeroAgi(h, false)
    set KKP_h_int[pid]=GetHeroInt(h, false)
    set KKP_h_forb[pid]=GetHeroStr(h, true)
    set KKP_h_agib[pid]=GetHeroAgi(h, true)
    set KKP_h_intb[pid]=GetHeroInt(h, true)
    set KKP_h_vida[pid]=R2I(GetWidgetLife(h))
    set KKP_h_vidamax[pid]=BlzGetUnitMaxHP(h)
    set KKP_h_mana[pid]=R2I(GetUnitState(h, UNIT_STATE_MANA))
    set KKP_h_manamax[pid]=BlzGetUnitMaxMana(h)
    set KKP_h_arm[pid]=BlzGetUnitArmor(h)
    set KKP_h_dano1[pid]=BlzGetUnitBaseDamage(h, 0)+BlzGetUnitDiceNumber(h, 0)
    set KKP_h_dano2[pid]=BlzGetUnitBaseDamage(h, 0)+BlzGetUnitDiceNumber(h, 0)*BlzGetUnitDiceSides(h, 0)
    set KKP_h_cd[pid]=BlzGetUnitAttackCooldown(h, 0)
    set KKP_h_vel[pid]=R2I(GetUnitMoveSpeed(h))
    set h=null
endfunction

function KKP_amostra_grade takes integer pid returns nothing
    set KKP_arg_pid=pid
    set KKP_arg_aba=KKP_aba[pid]
    call KKP_chama(KKP_G_GRADE)
endfunction

function KKP_fav_le takes integer pid returns nothing
    local string s
    local integer i=0
    local integer x
    set KKP_arg_pid=pid
    set KKP_arg_ok=true
    set KKP_arg_s=""
    call KKP_chama(KKP_G_FAV_LE)
    if not KKP_arg_ok then
        return
    endif
    set s=KKP_arg_s
    if s==null then
        set s=""
    endif
    set KKP_favn[pid]=0
    loop
        exitwhen i+4>StringLength(s) or KKP_favn[pid]>=40
        set x=KKP_s2id(SubString(s, i, i+4))
        if KKP_idx(x)>0 and not LoadBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, x) then
            set KKP_favn[pid]=KKP_favn[pid]+1
            set KKP_fav[pid*64+KKP_favn[pid]]=x
            call SaveBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, x, true)
        endif
        set i=i+4
    endloop
    set KKP_fav_ok[pid]=true
endfunction

function KKP_fav_troca takes player p,integer x returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local integer i=1
    local integer j
    local string s=""
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or KKP_idx(x)<1 then
        return
    endif
    if LoadBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, x) then
        call RemoveSavedBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, x)
        loop
            exitwhen i>KKP_favn[pid]
            if KKP_fav[pid*64+i]==x then
                set j=i
                loop
                    exitwhen j>=KKP_favn[pid]
                    set KKP_fav[pid*64+j]=KKP_fav[pid*64+j+1]
                    set j=j+1
                endloop
                set KKP_favn[pid]=KKP_favn[pid]-1
                exitwhen true
            endif
            set i=i+1
        endloop
    elseif KKP_favn[pid]<40 then
        set KKP_favn[pid]=KKP_favn[pid]+1
        set KKP_fav[pid*64+KKP_favn[pid]]=x
        call SaveBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, x, true)
    else
        call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "|cffff5555Favorites are full (40). Remove one first.|r")
        return
    endif
    set i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_favn[pid]
        set s=s+KKP_id2s(KKP_fav[pid*64+i])
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set KKP_arg_pid=pid
    set KKP_arg_s=s
    call KKP_chama(KKP_G_FAV_GRAVA)
endfunction

function KKP_poe takes framehandle f,real x,real y,real w,real h returns nothing
    call BlzFrameClearAllPoints(f)
    call BlzFrameSetAbsPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, x+KKP_DX, y)
    call BlzFrameSetSize(f, w, h)
endfunction

function KKP_img takes framehandle pai,string tex,real x,real y,real w,real h returns framehandle
    local framehandle f=BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "KKPImg", pai, "", 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(f, x, y, w, h)
    call BlzFrameSetTexture(f, tex, 0, true)
    return f
endfunction

function KKP_caixa_nova takes framehandle pai,boolean apertada,real x,real y,real w,real h returns framehandle
    local framehandle f
    if apertada then
        set f=BlzCreateFrame("QuestButtonPushedBackdropTemplate", pai, 0, 0)
    else
        set f=BlzCreateFrame("QuestButtonBaseTemplate", pai, 0, 0)
    endif
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(f, x, y, w, h)
    return f
endfunction

function KKP_txt takes framehandle pai,string modelo,real x,real y,real w,real h returns framehandle
    local framehandle f=BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "KKPTxt", pai, modelo, 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(f, x, y, w, h)
    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_TOP, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "")
    return f
endfunction

function KKP_bt takes framehandle pai,real x,real y,real w,real h,integer cod,boolean roda returns framehandle
    local framehandle b=BlzCreateFrameByType("BUTTON", "KKPBt", pai, "ScoreScreenTabButtonTemplate", 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(b, x, y, w, h)
    call SaveInteger(KKP_ht, GetHandleId(b), 0, cod)
    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(KKP_t_clique, b, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
    if roda then
        call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(KKP_t_roda, b, FRAMEEVENT_MOUSE_WHEEL)
    endif
    return b
endfunction

function KKP_btxt takes framehandle pai,string rot,real x,real y,real w,real h,integer cod returns framehandle
    local framehandle b=BlzCreateFrameByType("GLUETEXTBUTTON", "KKPBtTxt", pai, "ScriptDialogButton", 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(b, x, y, w, h)
    call BlzFrameSetText(b, rot)
    call SaveInteger(KKP_ht, GetHandleId(b), 0, cod)
    call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 0, b)
    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(KKP_t_clique, b, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
    return b
endfunction

function KKP_linha takes framehandle pai,real x,real y,real w,real h,integer cod,boolean ico,boolean info returns nothing
    local real tx=x+0.006
    local real tw
    local framehandle f
    call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 1, KKP_caixa_nova(pai, false, x, y, w, h))
    set f=KKP_caixa_nova(pai, true, x, y, w, h)
    call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, false)
    call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 2, f)
    if ico then
        set f=KKP_img(pai, "UI\\Widgets\\Console\\Human\\CommandButton\\human-activebutton.blp", x+0.001, y-0.001, h-0.002, h-0.002)
        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, false)
        call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 7, f)
        call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 3, KKP_img(pai, "ReplaceableTextures\\CommandButtons\\BTNSelectHeroOn.blp", x+0.003, y-0.003, h-0.006, h-0.006))
        set tx=x+h+0.002
    endif
    set tw=x+w-tx-0.004
    if info then
        set tw=tw-0.078
    endif
    set f=KKP_txt(pai, "EscMenuLabelTextSmallTemplate", tx, y, tw, h)
    if ico then
        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
    else
        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
    endif
    call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 4, f)
    if info then
        set f=KKP_txt(pai, "EscMenuLabelTextSmallTemplate", x+w-0.082, y, 0.078, h)
        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_RIGHT)
        call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 6, f)
    endif
    call SaveFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 5, KKP_bt(pai, x, y, w, h, cod, true))
    set f=null
endfunction

function KKP_vis takes framehandle f,boolean v returns nothing
    if f!=null then
        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, v)
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_lvis takes integer cod,boolean v returns nothing
    local integer k=1
    loop
        exitwhen k>7
        if (k!=2 and k!=7) or not v then
            call KKP_vis(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, k), v)
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_lativa takes integer cod,string s,boolean ativo returns nothing
    call KKP_vis(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 2), ativo)
    call KKP_vis(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 7), ativo)
    call KKP_vis(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 1), not ativo)
    if LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 4)!=null then
        if ativo then
            call BlzFrameSetText(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 4), "|cffffcc00"+s+"|r")
        else
            call BlzFrameSetText(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 4), s)
        endif
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_rot takes integer cod,string s,boolean ativo returns nothing
    local framehandle b=LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 0)
    if b!=null then
        if ativo then
            call BlzFrameSetText(b, "|cffffcc00"+s+"|r")
        else
            call BlzFrameSetText(b, "|cffd0d0d0"+s+"|r")
        endif
    endif
    set b=null
endfunction

function KKP_bvis takes integer cod,boolean v returns nothing
    call KKP_vis(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, cod, 0), v)
endfunction

function KKP_tem takes integer pid,integer x returns integer
    local integer n=0
    local integer k=0
    local integer s
    local unit u
    local item it
    loop
        exitwhen k>4
        if k==0 then
            set u=KKP_heroi[pid]
        else
            set u=KKP_inv_u[pid*4+k-1]
        endif
        if u!=null then
            set s=0
            loop
                exitwhen s>5
                set it=UnitItemInSlot(u, s)
                if it!=null and GetItemTypeId(it)==x then
                    if GetItemCharges(it)>1 then
                        set n=n+GetItemCharges(it)
                    else
                        set n=n+1
                    endif
                endif
                set s=s+1
            endloop
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
    set u=null
    set it=null
    return n
endfunction

function KKP_des_ficha takes integer pid returns nothing
    local string s
    if not KKP_h_ok[pid] then
        call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_f_ico, "ReplaceableTextures\\CommandButtons\\BTNSelectHeroOn.blp", 0, true)
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_f_nome, "|cffffcc00"+KKP_txt_sem_heroi+"|r")
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_f_stat, "")
    else
        call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_f_ico, BlzGetAbilityIcon(KKP_h_tipo[pid]), 0, true)
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_f_nome, "|cffffcc00"+KKP_h_nome[pid]+"|r|nLevel "+I2S(KKP_h_nivel[pid]))
        set s="|cffffcc00Strength:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_forb[pid])+"|n|cff999999   base "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_for[pid])+"|r"
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Agility:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_agib[pid])+"|n|cff999999   base "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_agi[pid])+"|r"
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Intelligence:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_intb[pid])+"|n|cff999999   base "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_int[pid])+"|r"
        set s=s+"|n|n|cffffcc00HP:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_vida[pid])+" / "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_vidamax[pid])
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00MP:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_mana[pid])+" / "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_manamax[pid])
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Armor:|r "+R2SW(KKP_h_arm[pid], 1, 1)
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Damage:|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_dano1[pid])+" - "+KKP_mil(KKP_h_dano2[pid])
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Attack cooldown:|r "+R2SW(KKP_h_cd[pid], 1, 2)+" s"
        set s=s+"|n|cffffcc00Move speed:|r "+I2S(KKP_h_vel[pid])
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_f_stat, s)
    endif
    set s=KKP_x_mapa[pid]
    if s==null then
        set s=""
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_f_mapa, s)
endfunction

function KKP_c_tam takes integer pid returns integer
    if KKP_c_q!="" then
        return KKP_res_n
    elseif KKP_c_cat==0 then
        return KKP_favn[pid]
    endif
    return KKP_cat_qt[KKP_c_cat]
endfunction

function KKP_c_item takes integer pid,integer i returns integer
    if KKP_c_q!="" then
        return KKP_res[i]
    elseif KKP_c_cat==0 then
        return KKP_idx(KKP_fav[pid*64+i])
    endif
    return KKP_cat_ini[KKP_c_cat]+i-1
endfunction

function KKP_des_codex_lista takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer n=KKP_c_tam(pid)
    local integer s=1
    local integer k=0
    local integer x
    local string nome
    local boolean achou=false
    loop
        exitwhen k>KKP_cat_n
        if k==0 then
            call KKP_lativa(3000, "Favorites", KKP_c_q=="" and KKP_c_cat==0)
        else
            call KKP_lativa(3000+k, KKP_cat_nome[k], KKP_c_q=="" and KKP_c_cat==k)
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
    if KKP_c_top>n-11 then
        set KKP_c_top=n-11
    endif
    if KKP_c_top<0 then
        set KKP_c_top=0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen s>11
        if KKP_c_top+s<=n then
            set x=KKP_c_item(pid, KKP_c_top+s)
            set KKP_c_lin[s]=x
            set nome=KKP_nome_item(KKP_it[x])
            if LoadBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, KKP_it[x]) then
                set nome=nome+"|r |cffffcc00*|r"
            endif
            call KKP_lvis(4000+s, true)
            call BlzFrameSetTexture(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 4000+s, 3), KKP_ico_item(KKP_it[x]), 0, true)
            call KKP_lativa(4000+s, nome, x==KKP_c_sel)
        else
            set KKP_c_lin[s]=0
            call KKP_lvis(4000+s, false)
        endif
        set s=s+1
    endloop
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_pag, KKP_pagina(KKP_c_top, 11, n))
    if KKP_c_q!="" then
        if KKP_res_i>0 then
            call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_btxt, "|cff999999Searching...|r")
        elseif n==1 then
            call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_btxt, "|cffffcc001|r result for \""+KKP_c_q+"\"")
        else
            call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_btxt, "|cffffcc00"+I2S(n)+"|r results for \""+KKP_c_q+"\"")
        endif
    elseif KKP_c_cat==0 then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_btxt, "|cffffcc00Favorites|r: "+I2S(n)+" |cff999999(open an item, click Favorite)|r")
    else
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_btxt, "|cffffcc00"+KKP_cat_nome[KKP_c_cat]+"|r: "+I2S(n)+" items")
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_des_codex_det takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer x=KKP_c_sel
    local integer id
    local integer r
    local integer n=0
    local integer m=1
    local integer k
    local integer ing
    local integer q
    local integer tem
    local integer prontos=0
    local integer un
    local boolean ok
    local boolean vis=(x>0 and x<=KKP_it_n)
    local string s
    local string rs=""
    loop
        exitwhen m>8
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rico[m], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rbt[m], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rqt[m], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rok[m], false)
        set m=m+1
    endloop
    set m=1
    loop
        exitwhen m>6
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_uico[m], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_ubt[m], false)
        set m=m+1
    endloop
    call KKP_vis(KKP_c_dico, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_c_dnome, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_c_dsub, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rtit, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_c_utit, vis)
    call KKP_bvis(6003, vis)
    call KKP_bvis(6004, false)
    call KKP_bvis(6005, false)
    if not vis then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_desc, "|cffffcc00"+KKP_titulo+"|r|n|n"+KKP_txt_codex)
        return
    endif
    set id=KKP_it[x]
    call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_c_dico, KKP_ico_item(id), 0, true)
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_dnome, KKP_nome_item(id))
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_dsub, "|cff999999"+KKP_cat_nome[KKP_it_cat[x]]+"|r")
    if LoadBoolean(KKP_ht, 910000+pid, id) then
        call KKP_rot(6003, "Unfavorite", true)
    else
        call KKP_rot(6003, "Favorite", false)
    endif
    set r=KKP_it_rc[x]
    if r>0 then
        set n=IMinBJ(KKP_rc_ingn[r], 8)
    endif
    set KKP_c_rec_n=n
    set m=1
    loop
        exitwhen m>n
        set k=KKP_rc_ini[r]+m-1
        set ing=KKP_ing[k]
        set q=KKP_ing_qt[k]
        set tem=KKP_tem(pid, ing)
        set ok=tem>=IMaxBJ(q, 1)
        set KKP_c_rec[m]=ing
        call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_c_rico[m], KKP_ico_item(ing), 0, true)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rico[m], true)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rbt[m], KKP_idx(ing)>0)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rok[m], ok)
        if q>1 then
            if ok then
                call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_rqt[m], "|cff00ff00"+I2S(tem)+"/"+I2S(q)+"|r")
            else
                call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_rqt[m], "|cffff5555"+I2S(tem)+"/"+I2S(q)+"|r")
            endif
            call KKP_vis(KKP_c_rqt[m], true)
        endif
        if m>1 then
            set rs=rs+", "
        endif
        set rs=rs+KKP_nome_item(ing)+"|r"
        if q>1 then
            set rs=rs+" x"+I2S(q)
        endif
        if ok then
            set rs=rs+" |cff00ff00(carried)|r"
            set prontos=prontos+1
        endif
        set m=m+1
    endloop
    if n>0 then
        set s="|cffffcc00Recipe|r  "+I2S(prontos)+"/"+I2S(n)+" carried"
        if KKP_it_rcn[x]>1 then
            set s=s+" |cff999999(+"+I2S(KKP_it_rcn[x]-1)+" more)|r"
        endif
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_rtit, s)
    else
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_rtit, "|cffffcc00Recipe|r  |cff999999none: this item is not crafted|r")
    endif
    set un=KKP_it_usn[x]
    if KKP_c_utop>un-6 then
        set KKP_c_utop=un-6
    endif
    if KKP_c_utop<0 then
        set KKP_c_utop=0
    endif
    set m=1
    loop
        exitwhen m>6
        if KKP_c_utop+m<=un then
            call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_c_uico[m], KKP_ico_item(KKP_it[KKP_us[KKP_it_us[x]+KKP_c_utop+m-1]]), 0, true)
            call KKP_vis(KKP_c_uico[m], true)
            call KKP_vis(KKP_c_ubt[m], true)
        endif
        set m=m+1
    endloop
    call KKP_bvis(6004, KKP_c_utop>0)
    call KKP_bvis(6005, KKP_c_utop+6<un)
    if un>0 then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_utit, "|cffffcc00Used in|r  "+I2S(un)+" recipes |cff999999(click to open)|r")
    else
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_utit, "|cffffcc00Used in|r  |cff999999no recipe uses this item|r")
    endif
    set s=""
    if n>0 then
        set s="|cffffcc00Recipe:|r "+rs
        if KKP_rc_ouro[r]>0 then
            set s=s+" + "+KKP_mil(KKP_rc_ouro[r])+" gold"
        endif
        if KKP_rc_madeira[r]>0 then
            set s=s+" + "+KKP_mil(KKP_rc_madeira[r])+" lumber"
        endif
        if KKP_txt_receita!="" then
            set s=s+"|n|cff999999("+KKP_txt_receita+")|r"
        endif
        set s=s+"|n|n"
    endif
    set s=s+BlzGetAbilityExtendedTooltip(id, 0)
    set m=1
    if KKP_it_dpn[x]>0 then
        set s=s+"|n|n|r|cffffcc00Dropped by|r |cff999999(chance per kill, "+KKP_txt_taxa+")|r"
        loop
            exitwhen m>KKP_it_dpn[x] or m>14
            set k=KKP_it_dp[x]+m-1
            set s=s+"|n"+KKP_nome_chefe(KKP_dp_bs[k])+"|r: "+KKP_taxa_txt(KKP_dp_tipo[k], KKP_dp_taxa[k], pid)
            if KKP_dp_qt[k]>1 then
                set s=s+" x"+I2S(KKP_dp_qt[k])
            endif
            set m=m+1
        endloop
        if KKP_it_dpn[x]>14 then
            set s=s+"|n|cff999999+"+I2S(KKP_it_dpn[x]-14)+" more|r"
        endif
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_desc, s)
endfunction

function KKP_des_chefe_lista takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer g=KKP_b_grupo
    local integer n=KKP_gr_qt[g]
    local integer s=1
    local integer k=1
    local integer j
    local boolean achou=false
    loop
        exitwhen k>KKP_gr_n
        call KKP_rot(9000+k, KKP_gr_nome[k], k==g)
        set k=k+1
    endloop
    if KKP_b_top>n-11 then
        set KKP_b_top=n-11
    endif
    if KKP_b_top<0 then
        set KKP_b_top=0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen s>11
        if KKP_b_top+s<=n then
            set j=KKP_gr_ini[g]+KKP_b_top+s-1
            set KKP_b_lin[s]=j
            call KKP_lvis(10000+s, true)
            call BlzFrameSetTexture(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 10000+s, 3), KKP_ico_chefe(j), 0, true)
            call KKP_lativa(10000+s, KKP_nome_chefe(j)+"|r |cff999999Lv "+I2S(KKP_bs_nivel[j])+"|r", j==KKP_b_sel)
        else
            set KKP_b_lin[s]=0
            call KKP_lvis(10000+s, false)
        endif
        set s=s+1
    endloop
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_pag, KKP_pagina(KKP_b_top, 11, n))
endfunction

function KKP_des_chefe_det takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer j=KKP_b_sel
    local boolean vis=(j>0 and j<=KKP_bs_n)
    local integer s=1
    local integer k
    local integer it
    local string t
    call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dico, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dnome, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dinfo, vis)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dtit, vis)
    call KKP_bvis(13001, vis and KKP_bs_pos[j])
    loop
        exitwhen s>12
        set KKP_b_drop[s]=0
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dico2[s], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dbt[s], false)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dtx[s], false)
        set s=s+1
    endloop
    if not vis then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dnota, KKP_txt_chefes)
        return
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_b_dico, KKP_ico_chefe(j), 0, true)
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dnome, KKP_nome_chefe(j))
    set t="|cff999999"+KKP_gr_nome[KKP_bs_grupo[j]]+"|r"
    if KKP_bs_nivel[j]>0 then
        set t=t+"  |cffffcc00Level|r "+I2S(KKP_bs_nivel[j])
    endif
    if KKP_bs_vida[j]>0 then
        set t=t+"  |cffffcc00HP|r "+KKP_mil(KKP_bs_vida[j])
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dinfo, t)
    if KKP_bs_nota[j]!=null and KKP_bs_nota[j]!="" then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dnota, KKP_bs_nota[j])
    else
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dnota, "")
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dtit, "|cffffcc00Drops|r  "+I2S(KKP_bs_drn[j])+" |cff999999(chance per kill, "+KKP_txt_taxa+")|r")
    set s=1
    loop
        exitwhen s>12 or s>KKP_bs_drn[j]
        set k=KKP_bs_dr[j]+s-1
        set it=KKP_dr_it[k]
        set KKP_b_drop[s]=it
        call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_b_dico2[s], KKP_ico_item(it), 0, true)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dico2[s], true)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dbt[s], KKP_idx(it)>0)
        set t=KKP_nome_item(it)+"|r|n"+KKP_taxa_txt(KKP_dr_tipo[k], KKP_dr_taxa[k], pid)
        if KKP_dr_qt[k]>1 then
            set t=t+" x"+I2S(KKP_dr_qt[k])
        endif
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_b_dtx[s], t)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_b_dtx[s], true)
        set s=s+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_bit takes integer x,integer k returns boolean
    if k==2 then
        return ModuloInteger(x/2, 2)==1
    endif
    return ModuloInteger(x, 2)==1
endfunction

function KKP_des_mapa takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer a=KKP_aba[pid]
    local integer sub=KKP_g_sub
    local integer b=pid*16+sub
    local integer n=KKP_g_n[b]
    local integer lay=KKP_ab_lay[a*16+sub]
    local integer s=1
    local integer i
    local integer e
    local integer k=1
    local boolean achou=false
    local boolean ok
    local string t
    loop
        exitwhen k>10
        if k<=KKP_ab_subn[a] then
            call KKP_bvis(16000+k, true)
            call KKP_rot(16000+k, KKP_ab_sub[a*16+k], k==sub)
        else
            call KKP_bvis(16000+k, false)
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
    if n>KKP_GE then
        set n=KKP_GE
    endif
    if lay==2 then
        if KKP_g_top>n-KKP_GL then
            set KKP_g_top=n-KKP_GL
        endif
    elseif KKP_g_top>n-1 then
        set KKP_g_top=((n-1)/40)*40
    endif
    if KKP_g_top<0 then
        set KKP_g_top=0
    endif
    call KKP_vis(KKP_g_corpo1, lay!=2)
    call KKP_vis(KKP_g_corpo2, lay==2)
    if KKP_g_topo[b]!=null then
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_topo_tx, KKP_g_topo[b])
    else
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_topo_tx, "")
    endif
    if lay==2 then
        loop
            exitwhen s>KKP_GL
            set i=KKP_g_top+s-1
            if i<n then
                set e=b*KKP_GE+i
                set KKP_g_lin[s]=i
                call KKP_lvis(20000+s, true)
                call BlzFrameSetTexture(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 20000+s, 3), KKP_g_ico[e], 0, true)
                if KKP_g_trava[e] then
                    call KKP_lativa(20000+s, "|cff808080"+KKP_g_nome[e]+"|r", i==KKP_g_sel)
                else
                    call KKP_lativa(20000+s, KKP_g_nome[e], i==KKP_g_sel)
                endif
                if KKP_g_info[e]!=null then
                    call BlzFrameSetText(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 20000+s, 6), KKP_g_info[e])
                else
                    call BlzFrameSetText(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 20000+s, 6), "")
                endif
            else
                set KKP_g_lin[s]=-1
                call KKP_lvis(20000+s, false)
            endif
            set s=s+1
        endloop
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_l_pag, KKP_pagina(KKP_g_top, KKP_GL, n))
    else
        loop
            exitwhen s>40
            set i=KKP_g_top+s-1
            if i<n then
                set e=b*KKP_GE+i
                set KKP_g_lin[s]=i
                call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_g_icof[s], KKP_g_ico[e], 0, true)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_icof[s], true)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_bt[s], true)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_dim[s], KKP_g_trava[e])
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_cur[s], KKP_g_ok[e])
                if i==KKP_g_sel then
                    call BlzFrameClearAllPoints(KKP_g_marca)
                    call BlzFrameSetPoint(KKP_g_marca, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, KKP_g_icof[s], FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, -0.003, 0.003)
                    call BlzFrameSetPoint(KKP_g_marca, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOMRIGHT, KKP_g_icof[s], FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOMRIGHT, 0.003, -0.003)
                    set achou=true
                endif
            else
                set KKP_g_lin[s]=-1
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_icof[s], false)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_bt[s], false)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_dim[s], false)
                call KKP_vis(KKP_g_cur[s], false)
            endif
            set s=s+1
        endloop
        call KKP_vis(KKP_g_marca, achou)
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_pag, KKP_pagina(KKP_g_top, 40, n))
    endif
    set i=KKP_g_sel
    if i<0 or i>=n then
        set i=KKP_g_atual[b]
    endif
    set ok=i>=0 and i<n
    if ok then
        set e=b*KKP_GE+i
        call BlzFrameSetTexture(KKP_g_dico, KKP_g_ico[e], 0, true)
        call KKP_vis(KKP_g_dico, true)
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_dnome, "|cffffcc00"+KKP_g_nome[e]+"|r")
        set t=""
        if KKP_g_trava[e] then
            set t="|cffff5555Locked.|r|n"
        endif
        if KKP_g_edet[e]!=null and KKP_g_edet[e]!="" then
            set t=t+KKP_g_edet[e]
        endif
    else
        set e=0
        call KKP_vis(KKP_g_dico, false)
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_dnome, "")
        if n>0 then
            set t="|cff999999Pick an entry on the left.|r"
        else
            set t="|cff999999Nothing here yet.|r"
        endif
    endif
    if KKP_g_det[b]!=null and KKP_g_det[b]!="" then
        set t=t+"|n|n"+KKP_g_det[b]
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_g_dtxt, t)
    set k=1
    loop
        exitwhen k>2
        if k==1 then
            set t=KKP_g_b1[b]
        else
            set t=KKP_g_b2[b]
        endif
        if t==null or t=="" then
            call KKP_bvis(17000+k, false)
        elseif KKP_bit(KKP_g_bm[b], k) and not (ok and KKP_bit(KKP_g_eb[e], k)) then
            call KKP_bvis(17000+k, false)
        else
            call BlzFrameSetText(LoadFrameHandle(KKP_ht, 17000+k, 0), t)
            call KKP_bvis(17000+k, true)
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_des_abas takes integer pid returns nothing
    local integer i=1
    local integer a=KKP_aba[pid]
    local integer t=KKP_aba_tipo[a]
    loop
        exitwhen i>4
        call KKP_vis(KKP_pag[i], i==t)
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
        call KKP_rot(1000+i, KKP_aba_nome[i], i==a)
        set i=i+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_desenha takes boolean detalhe returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer t
    if not KKP_pronto or pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores then
        return
    endif
    if not KKP_aberto[pid] then
        call BlzFrameSetVisible(KKP_raiz, false)
        return
    endif
    call BlzFrameSetVisible(KKP_raiz, true)
    call KKP_des_abas(pid)
    set t=KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]
    if t==1 then
        call KKP_des_ficha(pid)
    elseif t==2 then
        call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        if detalhe then
            set KKP_c_pend=true
        endif
    elseif t==3 then
        call KKP_des_chefe_lista()
        if detalhe then
            set KKP_b_pend=true
        endif
    elseif t==4 then
        if KKP_g_aba!=KKP_aba[pid] then
            set KKP_g_aba=KKP_aba[pid]
            set KKP_g_sub=1
            set KKP_g_top=0
            set KKP_g_sel=-1
        endif
        call KKP_des_mapa()
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_limpa_busca takes nothing returns nothing
    local string t=BlzFrameGetText(KKP_c_busca)
    set KKP_c_q=""
    set KKP_res_i=0
    call BlzFrameSetFocus(KKP_c_busca, false)
    if t!=null and t!="" then
        set KKP_c_ign=StringCase(t, false)
        set KKP_c_eco=true
        set KKP_c_eco_t=40
        call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_c_busca, "")
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_abre_item takes integer k returns nothing
    if k<1 or k>KKP_it_n then
        return
    endif
    set KKP_c_sel=k
    set KKP_c_utop=0
    call KKP_limpa_busca()
    set KKP_c_cat=KKP_it_cat[k]
    set KKP_c_top=k-KKP_cat_ini[KKP_c_cat]-5
    set KKP_c_pend=true
endfunction

function KKP_aba_do_tipo takes integer t returns integer
    local integer i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
        if KKP_aba_tipo[i]==t then
            return i
        endif
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    return 0
endfunction

function KKP_aba_de_id takes string id returns integer
    local integer i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
        if KKP_aba_id[i]==id then
            return i
        endif
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    return 0
endfunction

function KKP_campo takes string s,integer n returns string
    local integer i=0
    local integer ini=0
    local integer k=0
    local integer len=StringLength(s)
    loop
        exitwhen i>len
        if i==len or SubString(s, i, i+1)=="|" then
            if k==n then
                return SubString(s, ini, i)
            endif
            set k=k+1
            set ini=i+1
        endif
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    return ""
endfunction

function KKP_pede takes integer aba returns nothing
    if aba>0 then
        call BlzSendSyncData("kkp", "O"+I2S(aba))
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_pede_id takes string id returns nothing
    call KKP_pede(KKP_aba_de_id(id))
endfunction

function KKP_amostra_aba takes integer pid returns nothing
    local integer t=KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]
    call KKP_amostra(pid)
    if t==4 then
        call KKP_amostra_grade(pid)
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_abre takes player p,integer aba returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or aba<1 or aba>KKP_aba_n then
        return
    endif
    if not KKP_pronto then
        call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "|cffffcc00The "+KKP_titulo+" opens a moment after the game starts.|r")
        return
    endif
    if KKP_aberto[pid] and KKP_aba[pid]==aba then
        set KKP_aberto[pid]=false
    else
        set KKP_aberto[pid]=true
        set KKP_aba[pid]=aba
        call KKP_amostra_aba(pid)
    endif
    if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
        call KKP_desenha(true)
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_vai takes player p,integer aba returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    if aba<1 or aba>KKP_aba_n then
        return
    endif
    set KKP_aberto[pid]=true
    set KKP_aba[pid]=aba
    call KKP_amostra_aba(pid)
endfunction

function KKP_mostra takes player p,integer aba returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or aba<1 or aba>KKP_aba_n then
        return
    endif
    if not KKP_pronto then
        call DisplayTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, "|cffffcc00The "+KKP_titulo+" opens a moment after the game starts.|r")
        return
    endif
    call KKP_vai(p, aba)
    if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
        call KKP_desenha(true)
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_mostra_id takes player p,string id returns nothing
    call KKP_mostra(p, KKP_aba_de_id(id))
endfunction

function KKP_tecla takes nothing returns nothing
    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
    local oskeytype k=BlzGetTriggerPlayerKey()
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local integer i=1
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores then
        set p=null
        set k=null
        return
    endif
    if k==OSKEY_ESCAPE then
        if KKP_pronto and KKP_aberto[pid] then
            set KKP_aberto[pid]=false
            if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
                call KKP_desenha(false)
            endif
        endif
    else
        loop
            exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
            if KKP_aba_tecla[i]>0 and k==ConvertOsKeyType(KKP_aba_tecla[i]) then
                call KKP_abre(p, i)
                exitwhen true
            endif
            set i=i+1
        endloop
    endif
    set p=null
    set k=null
endfunction

function KKP_clique_local takes integer g,integer i returns nothing
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    local integer x
    local integer j
    if g==3 then
        set KKP_c_cat=i
        set KKP_c_top=0
        call KKP_limpa_busca()
        call KKP_des_codex_lista()
    elseif g==4 then
        set x=KKP_c_lin[i]
        if x!=0 then
            set KKP_c_sel=x
            set KKP_c_utop=0
            set KKP_c_pend=true
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        endif
    elseif g==5 then
        if i==1 then
            set KKP_c_top=KKP_c_top-11
        else
            set KKP_c_top=KKP_c_top+11
        endif
        call KKP_des_codex_lista()
    elseif g==6 then
        if i==3 and KKP_c_sel>0 then
            call BlzSendSyncData("kkp", "F"+KKP_id2s(KKP_it[KKP_c_sel]))
        elseif i==4 then
            set KKP_c_utop=KKP_c_utop-6
            set KKP_c_pend=true
        elseif i==5 then
            set KKP_c_utop=KKP_c_utop+6
            set KKP_c_pend=true
        elseif i==6 then
            call KKP_limpa_busca()
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        endif
    elseif g==7 then
        if i<=KKP_c_rec_n and KKP_idx(KKP_c_rec[i])>0 then
            call KKP_abre_item(KKP_idx(KKP_c_rec[i]))
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        endif
    elseif g==8 then
        if KKP_c_sel>0 and KKP_c_utop+i<=KKP_it_usn[KKP_c_sel] then
            call KKP_abre_item(KKP_us[KKP_it_us[KKP_c_sel]+KKP_c_utop+i-1])
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        endif
    elseif g==9 then
        set KKP_b_grupo=i
        set KKP_b_top=0
        call KKP_des_chefe_lista()
    elseif g==10 then
        set j=KKP_b_lin[i]
        if j!=0 then
            set KKP_b_sel=j
            set KKP_b_pend=true
            call KKP_des_chefe_lista()
        endif
    elseif g==11 then
        if i==1 then
            set KKP_b_top=KKP_b_top-11
        else
            set KKP_b_top=KKP_b_top+11
        endif
        call KKP_des_chefe_lista()
    elseif g==13 then
        if i==1 and KKP_b_sel>0 and KKP_bs_pos[KKP_b_sel] then
            call PingMinimap(KKP_bs_x[KKP_b_sel], KKP_bs_y[KKP_b_sel], 4.00)
        endif
    elseif g==14 or g==20 then
        if KKP_g_lin[i]>=0 then
            set KKP_g_sel=KKP_g_lin[i]
            call KKP_des_mapa()
        endif
    elseif g==15 or g==21 then
        if g==15 then
            set j=40
        else
            set j=KKP_GL
        endif
        if i==1 then
            set KKP_g_top=KKP_g_top-j
        else
            set KKP_g_top=KKP_g_top+j
        endif
        call KKP_des_mapa()
    elseif g==16 then
        set KKP_g_sub=i
        set KKP_g_top=0
        set KKP_g_sel=-1
        call KKP_des_mapa()
    elseif g==17 then
        call BlzSendSyncData("kkp", "G"+I2S(KKP_aba[pid])+"|"+I2S(KKP_g_sub)+"|"+I2S(KKP_g_sel)+"|"+I2S(i))
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_clique takes nothing returns nothing
    local framehandle f=BlzGetTriggerFrame()
    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local integer c=LoadInteger(KKP_ht, GetHandleId(f), 0)
    local integer g=c/1000
    local integer i=c-g*1000
    local integer x
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or c<=0 or not KKP_pronto then
        set f=null
        set p=null
        return
    endif
    if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
        call BlzFrameSetEnable(f, false)
        call BlzFrameSetEnable(f, true)
        call BlzFrameSetFocus(KKP_c_busca, false)
    endif
    if g==1 then
        call KKP_vai(p, i)
        if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
            call KKP_desenha(true)
        endif
    elseif g==2 then
        set KKP_aberto[pid]=false
        if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
            call KKP_desenha(false)
        endif
    elseif g==12 then
        set x=KKP_aba_do_tipo(2)
        if x>0 then
            call KKP_vai(p, x)
            if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
                call KKP_abre_item(KKP_idx(KKP_b_drop[i]))
                call KKP_desenha(true)
            endif
        endif
    elseif g!=19 and GetLocalPlayer()==p then
        call KKP_clique_local(g, i)
    endif
    set f=null
    set p=null
endfunction

function KKP_roda takes nothing returns nothing
    local framehandle f=BlzGetTriggerFrame()
    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local integer c=LoadInteger(KKP_ht, GetHandleId(f), 0)
    local integer g=c/1000
    local integer d=-1
    local integer t
    if BlzGetTriggerFrameValue()<0.0 then
        set d=1
    endif
    if pid>=0 and pid<KKP_jogadores and KKP_pronto and GetLocalPlayer()==p and KKP_aberto[pid] then
        set t=KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]
        if g==8 then
            set KKP_c_utop=KKP_c_utop+d
            set KKP_c_pend=true
        elseif t==2 then
            set KKP_c_top=KKP_c_top+d
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        elseif t==3 then
            set KKP_b_top=KKP_b_top+d
            call KKP_des_chefe_lista()
        elseif t==4 then
            if KKP_ab_lay[KKP_aba[pid]*16+KKP_g_sub]==2 then
                set KKP_g_top=KKP_g_top+d
            else
                set KKP_g_top=KKP_g_top+d*40
            endif
            call KKP_des_mapa()
        endif
    endif
    set f=null
    set p=null
endfunction

function KKP_busca_evento takes nothing returns nothing
    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local string q=BlzGetTriggerFrameText()
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or not KKP_pronto then
        set p=null
        return
    endif
    if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
        if BlzGetTriggerFrameEvent()==FRAMEEVENT_EDITBOX_ENTER then
            call BlzFrameSetFocus(KKP_c_busca, false)
        endif
        if q==null then
            set q=""
        endif
        set q=StringCase(q, false)
        if KKP_c_eco then
            if q=="" then
                set KKP_c_eco=false
            endif
            set q=KKP_c_q
        elseif q!="" and q==KKP_c_ign then
            set q=KKP_c_q
        elseif q!=KKP_c_q then
            set KKP_c_ign=""
        endif
        if q!=KKP_c_q then
            set KKP_c_q=q
            set KKP_c_top=0
            set KKP_res_n=0
            if q!="" then
                set KKP_res_i=1
            else
                set KKP_res_i=0
            endif
            if KKP_aberto[pid] and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==2 then
                call KKP_des_codex_lista()
            endif
        endif
    endif
    set p=null
endfunction

function KKP_sync takes nothing returns nothing
    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
    local string v=BlzGetTriggerSyncData()
    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
    local string c
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores or not KKP_pronto or v==null or StringLength(v)<2 then
        set p=null
        return
    endif
    set c=SubString(v, 0, 1)
    if c=="F" and StringLength(v)==5 then
        call KKP_fav_troca(p, KKP_s2id(SubString(v, 1, 5)))
        if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
            set KKP_c_pend=true
            if KKP_aberto[pid] and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==2 then
                call KKP_des_codex_lista()
            endif
        endif
    elseif c=="O" then
        call KKP_abre(p, S2I(SubString(v, 1, StringLength(v))))
    elseif c=="G" then
        set v=SubString(v, 1, StringLength(v))
        set KKP_arg_pid=pid
        set KKP_arg_aba=S2I(KKP_campo(v, 0))
        set KKP_arg_sub=S2I(KKP_campo(v, 1))
        set KKP_arg_i=S2I(KKP_campo(v, 2))
        set KKP_arg_btn=S2I(KKP_campo(v, 3))
        set KKP_arg_ok=false
        if KKP_arg_aba>=1 and KKP_arg_aba<=KKP_aba_n and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_arg_aba]==4 and KKP_arg_sub>=1 and KKP_arg_sub<=KKP_ab_subn[KKP_arg_aba] and KKP_arg_i>=-1 and KKP_arg_i<KKP_GE and KKP_arg_btn>=1 and KKP_arg_btn<=2 then
            call KKP_chama(KKP_G_APLICA)
            if KKP_aberto[pid] and KKP_aba[pid]==KKP_arg_aba then
                call KKP_amostra_grade(pid)
                if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
                    call KKP_des_mapa()
                endif
            endif
        endif
    endif
    set p=null
endfunction

function KKP_tique1 takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid=0
    local integer t
    if not KKP_pronto then
        return
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen pid>=KKP_jogadores
        if not KKP_fav_ok[pid] and GetPlayerSlotState(Player(pid))==PLAYER_SLOT_STATE_PLAYING then
            call KKP_fav_le(pid)
        endif
        if KKP_aberto[pid] then
            call KKP_amostra(pid)
            if KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==4 then
                call KKP_amostra_grade(pid)
            endif
        endif
        set pid=pid+1
    endloop
    set pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    if pid>=0 and pid<KKP_jogadores and KKP_aberto[pid] then
        set t=KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]
        if t==1 then
            call KKP_des_ficha(pid)
        elseif t==4 and KKP_g_aba==KKP_aba[pid] then
            call KKP_des_mapa()
        endif
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_tique_local takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer pid
    local integer i
    local integer fim
    if not KKP_pronto then
        return
    endif
    set pid=GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())
    if pid<0 or pid>=KKP_jogadores then
        return
    endif
    if KKP_c_eco then
        set KKP_c_eco_t=KKP_c_eco_t-1
        if KKP_c_eco_t<=0 then
            set KKP_c_eco=false
        endif
    endif
    if KKP_res_i>0 then
        set i=KKP_res_i
        set fim=IMinBJ(KKP_it_n, i+149)
        loop
            exitwhen i>fim
            if KKP_contem(KKP_it_busca[i], KKP_c_q) then
                set KKP_res_n=KKP_res_n+1
                set KKP_res[KKP_res_n]=i
            endif
            set i=i+1
        endloop
        if i>KKP_it_n then
            set KKP_res_i=0
        else
            set KKP_res_i=i
        endif
        if KKP_res_i==0 and KKP_aberto[pid] and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==2 then
            call KKP_des_codex_lista()
        endif
        return
    endif
    if not KKP_aberto[pid] then
        return
    endif
    if KKP_c_pend and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==2 then
        set KKP_c_pend=false
        call KKP_des_codex_det()
    elseif KKP_b_pend and KKP_aba_tipo[KKP_aba[pid]]==3 then
        set KKP_b_pend=false
        call KKP_des_chefe_det()
    endif
endfunction

function KKP_cria_base takes nothing returns nothing
    local framehandle ui=BlzGetOriginFrame(ORIGIN_FRAME_GAME_UI, 0)
    local integer i=1
    local integer n=0
    local real x=0.100
    local real w
    set KKP_raiz=BlzCreateFrameByType("FRAME", "KKPRaiz", ui, "", 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call BlzFrameSetLevel(KKP_raiz, 6)
    set KKP_caixa=BlzCreateFrame("EscMenuBackdrop", KKP_raiz, 0, 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(KKP_caixa, 0.08, 0.575, 0.71, 0.44)
    set KKP_fundo=BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "KKPFundo", KKP_raiz, "", 0)
    set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
    call KKP_poe(KKP_fundo, 0.08, 0.575, 0.71, 0.44)
    call BlzFrameSetText(KKP_fundo, "")
    call SaveInteger(KKP_ht, GetHandleId(KKP_fundo), 0, 19000)
    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(KKP_t_clique, KKP_fundo, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(KKP_t_roda, KKP_fundo, FRAMEEVENT_MOUSE_WHEEL)
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
        set n=n+IMaxBJ(StringLength(KKP_aba_nome[i]), 4)
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_aba_n
        set w=(0.635-0.004*I2R(KKP_aba_n))*I2R(IMaxBJ(StringLength(KKP_aba_nome[i]), 4))/I2R(IMaxBJ(n, 1))
        call KKP_btxt(KKP_raiz, KKP_aba_nome[i], x, 0.556, w, 0.028, 1000+i)
        set x=x+w+0.004
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    call KKP_btxt(KKP_raiz, "X", 0.742, 0.556, 0.030, 0.028, 2001)
    set i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>4
        set KKP_pag[i]=BlzCreateFrameByType("FRAME", "KKPPag", KKP_raiz, "", 0)
        set KKP_nq=KKP_nq+1
        call BlzFrameSetVisible(KKP_pag[i], false)
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    call BlzFrameSetVisible(KKP_raiz, false)
    set ui=null
endfunction

function KKP_carga_indice takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=1
    local integer g
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_it_n
        call SaveInteger(KKP_ht, KKP_it[i], 1, i)
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set i=1
    loop
        exitwhen i>KKP_bs_n
        set g=KKP_bs_grupo[i]
        if KKP_gr_qt[g]==0 then
            set KKP_gr_ini[g]=i
        endif
        set KKP_gr_qt[g]=KKP_gr_qt[g]+1
        set i=i+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_carga_busca takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=KKP_carga_k
    local integer fim=IMinBJ(KKP_it_n, i+119)
    loop
        exitwhen i>fim
        set KKP_it_busca[i]=KKP_limpa(GetObjectName(KKP_it[i]))
        set i=i+1
    endloop
endfunction

function KKP_espera takes nothing returns nothing
    if KKP_iniciado then
        call PauseTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
        return
    endif
    set KKP_iniciado=true
    call PauseTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_cria_base")
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_cria_ficha")
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_cria_codex")
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_cria_chefes")
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_cria_mapa")
    set KKP_pronto=KKP_raiz!=null and KKP_c_desc!=null and KKP_g_dtxt!=null and KKP_f_mapa!=null
endfunction

function KKP_init takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=1
    local integer a
    set KKP_ht=InitHashtable()
    call KKP_dados_todos()
    call ExecuteFunc("KKP_carga_indice")
    set KKP_carga_k=1
    loop
        exitwhen KKP_carga_k>KKP_it_n
        call ExecuteFunc("KKP_carga_busca")
        set KKP_carga_k=KKP_carga_k+120
    endloop
    if KKP_toc!=null and KKP_toc!="" then
        call BlzLoadTOCFile(KKP_toc)
    endif
    set KKP_t_clique=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(KKP_t_clique, function KKP_clique)
    set KKP_t_roda=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(KKP_t_roda, function KKP_roda)
    set KKP_t_busca=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(KKP_t_busca, function KKP_busca_evento)
    set KKP_t_tecla=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(KKP_t_tecla, function KKP_tecla)
    set KKP_t_sync=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(KKP_t_sync, function KKP_sync)
    set i=0
    loop
        exitwhen i>=KKP_jogadores
        set a=1
        loop
            exitwhen a>KKP_aba_n
            if KKP_aba_tecla[a]>0 then
                call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(KKP_t_tecla, Player(i), ConvertOsKeyType(KKP_aba_tecla[a]), 0, false)
            endif
            set a=a+1
        endloop
        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(KKP_t_tecla, Player(i), OSKEY_ESCAPE, 0, false)
        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerSyncEvent(KKP_t_sync, Player(i), "kkp", false)
        set KKP_aberto[i]=false
        set KKP_aba[i]=1
        set KKP_favn[i]=0
        set KKP_mult[i]=1.0
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set KKP_tm_espera=CreateTimer()
    call TimerStart(KKP_tm_espera, 0.50, true, function KKP_espera)
    set KKP_tm_1s=CreateTimer()
    call TimerStart(KKP_tm_1s, 1.00, true, function KKP_tique1)
    set KKP_tm_local=CreateTimer()
    call TimerStart(KKP_tm_local, 0.05, true, function KKP_tique_local)
endfunction
```

`doctor/port/compat/kk_profiles_wait.j`:

```j
constant integer KK_PE_MAX=32
trigger array KK_pe_fila
integer KK_pe_n=0
boolean KK_pe_ligado=false
//{{KK_SE:KK_RELOGIO}}
constant integer KK_RL_MAX=256
trigger array KK_rl_fila
real array KK_rl_quando
integer KK_rl_n=0
real KK_rl_primeiro=-1.0
real KK_rl_atraso=0.0
boolean KK_rl_libera=false
timer KK_rl_relogio=null
hashtable KK_rl_ht=InitHashtable()

function KK_relogio_agora takes nothing returns real
    if KK_rl_relogio==null then
        return 0.0
    endif
    return TimerGetElapsed(KK_rl_relogio)
endfunction

function KK_relogio_roda takes trigger t returns nothing
    set KK_rl_libera=true
    call ConditionalTriggerExecute(t)
    set KK_rl_libera=false
endfunction

function KK_relogio_dispara takes nothing returns nothing
    local timer tm=GetExpiredTimer()
    local trigger t=LoadTriggerHandle(KK_rl_ht, GetHandleId(tm), 0)
    call FlushChildHashtable(KK_rl_ht, GetHandleId(tm))
    call DestroyTimer(tm)
    if t!=null then
        call KK_relogio_roda(t)
    endif
    set tm=null
    set t=null
endfunction

function KK_relogio_agenda takes trigger t,real espera returns nothing
    local timer tm
    if espera<=0.0 then
        call KK_relogio_roda(t)
        return
    endif
    set tm=CreateTimer()
    call SaveTriggerHandle(KK_rl_ht, GetHandleId(tm), 0, t)
    call TimerStart(tm, espera, false, function KK_relogio_dispara)
    set tm=null
endfunction

function KK_relogio_espera takes trigger t,real quando returns boolean
    if KK_rl_libera then
        set KK_rl_libera=false
        return false
    endif
    if t==null then
        return false
    endif
    if not DB_rede_pronto then
        if KK_rl_n<KK_RL_MAX then
            set KK_rl_fila[KK_rl_n]=t
            set KK_rl_quando[KK_rl_n]=quando
            set KK_rl_n=KK_rl_n+1
            if KK_rl_primeiro<0.0 or quando<KK_rl_primeiro then
                set KK_rl_primeiro=quando
            endif
            return true
        endif
        return false
    endif
    if KK_rl_atraso<=0.0 then
        return false
    endif
    call KK_relogio_agenda(t, KK_rl_atraso)
    return true
endfunction

function KK_relogio_pronto takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=0
    if KK_rl_n==0 then
        return
    endif
    set KK_rl_atraso=KK_relogio_agora()-KK_rl_primeiro
    if KK_rl_atraso<0.0 then
        set KK_rl_atraso=0.0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i>=KK_rl_n
        call KK_relogio_agenda(KK_rl_fila[i], KK_rl_quando[i]-KK_rl_primeiro)
        set KK_rl_fila[i]=null
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set KK_rl_n=0
endfunction
//{{KK_FIMSE:KK_RELOGIO}}

function KK_perfis_pronto takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=0
    local trigger t
    loop
        exitwhen i>=KK_pe_n
        set t=KK_pe_fila[i]
        set KK_pe_fila[i]=null
        if t!=null then
            call ConditionalTriggerExecute(t)
        endif
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    set KK_pe_n=0
    set t=null
    //{{KK_SE:KK_RELOGIO}}
    call KK_relogio_pronto()
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_RELOGIO}}
endfunction

function KK_perfis_depois takes trigger t returns nothing
    if t==null then
        return
    endif
    if DB_rede_pronto then
        call ConditionalTriggerExecute(t)
        return
    endif
    if KK_pe_n<KK_PE_MAX then
        set KK_pe_fila[KK_pe_n]=t
        set KK_pe_n=KK_pe_n+1
    endif
endfunction

function KK_perfis_prepara takes nothing returns nothing
    local trigger t
    if KK_pe_ligado then
        return
    endif
    set KK_pe_ligado=true
    //{{KK_SE:KK_RELOGIO}}
    set KK_rl_relogio=CreateTimer()
    call TimerStart(KK_rl_relogio, 1000000.0, false, null)
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_RELOGIO}}
    set DB_rede_aviso=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(DB_rede_aviso, function KK_perfis_pronto)
    set t=CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerAddAction(t, function DB_rede_init)
    call TriggerExecute(t)
    call DestroyTrigger(t)
    set t=null
endfunction
```

```j
function EXSetEffectColor takes effect e,integer argb returns nothing
    local integer b=ModuloInteger(argb,256)
    local integer rest=(argb-b)/256
    local integer g=ModuloInteger(rest,256)
    local integer r
    local integer a
    if e==null then
        return
    endif
    set rest=(rest-g)/256
    set r=ModuloInteger(rest,256)
    set a=ModuloInteger((rest-r)/256,256)
    call BlzSetSpecialEffectColor(e,r,g,b)
    call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,a)
    call SaveInteger(KKN_fx_alfa,GetHandleId(e),0,a)
endfunction

function EXSetEffectVisible takes effect e,boolean visible returns nothing
    if e==null then
        return
    endif
    if visible then
        if HaveSavedInteger(KKN_fx_alfa,GetHandleId(e),0) then
            call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,LoadInteger(KKN_fx_alfa,GetHandleId(e),0))
        else
            call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,255)
        endif
    else
        call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,0)
    endif
endfunction
```

```j
function KKN_frame_exec takes nothing returns nothing
    local string n=LoadStr(DB_ui_ht,GetHandleId(GetTriggeringTrigger()),1)
    if n!=null and n!="" then
        call ExecuteFunc(n)
    endif

function DzFrameSetScript takes integer frame,integer eventId,string xfunc,boolean sync returns nothing
    local trigger t
    if xfunc==null or xfunc=="" then
        call DzFrameSetScriptByCode(frame,eventId,null,sync)
        return
    endif
    call DzFrameSetScriptByCode(frame,eventId,function KKN_frame_exec,sync)
    set t=LoadTriggerHandle(DB_ui_ht,frame,100+eventId)
    if t!=null then
        call SaveStr(DB_ui_ht,GetHandleId(t),1,xfunc)
    endif
    set t=null
endfunction

function EXGetAbilityString takes integer abilcode,integer level,integer data_type returns string
    local integer lv=level-1
    if lv<0 then
        set lv=0
    endif
    if data_type==203 then
        return GetObjectName(abilcode)
    elseif data_type==204 then
        return BlzGetAbilityIcon(abilcode)
    elseif data_type==215 then
        return BlzGetAbilityTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==218 then
        return BlzGetAbilityExtendedTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==214 then
        return BlzGetAbilityResearchTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==217 then
        return BlzGetAbilityResearchExtendedTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==216 then
        return BlzGetAbilityActivatedTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==219 then
        return BlzGetAbilityActivatedExtendedTooltip(abilcode,lv)
    elseif data_type==220 then
        return BlzGetAbilityActivatedIcon(abilcode)
    endif
    return ""
endfunction
```

```j
constant string UJ_ASCII = " !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~"
constant string UJ_HEX = "0123456789ABCDEF"

function UJ_pot takes integer n returns integer
    local integer r = 1
    if n < 0 or n > 31 then
        return 0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen n == 0
        set r = r * 2
        set n = n - 1
    endloop
    return r
endfunction

function UJ_shr takes integer i, integer n returns integer
    if n <= 0 then
        return i
    endif
    if n >= 32 then
        return 0
    endif
    if n == 31 then
        if i < 0 then
            return 1
        endif
        return 0
    endif
    if i >= 0 then
        return i / UJ_pot(n)
    endif
    return BlzBitAnd(i, 2147483647) / UJ_pot(n) + UJ_pot(31 - n)
endfunction

function BitwiseNOT takes integer i returns integer
    return -1 - i
endfunction

function BitwiseAND takes integer a, integer b returns integer
    return BlzBitAnd(a, b)
endfunction

function BitwiseOR takes integer a, integer b returns integer
    return BlzBitOr(a, b)
endfunction

function BitwiseXOR takes integer a, integer b returns integer
    return BlzBitXor(a, b)
endfunction

function BitwiseShiftLeft takes integer i, integer bitsToShift returns integer
    if bitsToShift < 0 or bitsToShift > 31 then
        return 0
    endif
    return i * UJ_pot(bitsToShift)
endfunction

function BitwiseShiftLeftLogical takes integer i, integer bitsToShift returns integer
    if bitsToShift < 0 or bitsToShift > 31 then
        return 0
    endif
    return i * UJ_pot(bitsToShift)
endfunction

function BitwiseShiftRight takes integer i, integer bitsToShift returns integer
    if bitsToShift <= 0 then
        return i
    endif
    if bitsToShift >= 31 then
        if i < 0 then
            return -1
        endif
        return 0
    endif
    if i >= 0 then
        return i / UJ_pot(bitsToShift)
    endif
    return -((-(i + 1)) / UJ_pot(bitsToShift)) - 1
endfunction

function BitwiseShiftRightLogical takes integer i, integer bitsToShift returns integer
    return UJ_shr(i, bitsToShift)
endfunction

function BitwiseGetBit takes integer i, integer bitIndex returns integer

endfunction

function BitwiseSetBit takes integer i, integer bitIndex, integer bitValue returns integer
    if bitValue != 0 then
        return BlzBitOr(i, UJ_pot(bitIndex))
    endif
    return BlzBitAnd(i, -1 - UJ_pot(bitIndex))
endfunction

function BitwiseGetByte takes integer i, integer byteIndex returns integer
    return BlzBitAnd(UJ_shr(i, byteIndex * 8), 255)
endfunction

function BitwiseSetByte takes integer i, integer byteIndex, integer byteValue returns integer

endfunction

            return i + 32

function IntToHex takes integer i returns string

    local integer k = 0
    if i == 0 then
        return "0"
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i == 0 or k >= 8
        set s = SubString(UJ_HEX, BlzBitAnd(i, 15), BlzBitAnd(i, 15) + 1) + s
        set i = UJ_shr(i, 4)
        set k = k + 1
    endloop
    return s
endfunction

function HexToInt takes string hex returns integer
    local string s = StringCase(hex, true)
    local integer r = 0
    local integer i = 0
    local integer n = StringLength(s)
    local integer d
    local string c
    if SubString(s, 0, 2) == "0X" then
        set i = 2
    elseif SubString(s, 0, 1) == "$" then
        set i = 1
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i >= n
        set c = SubString(s, i, i + 1)
        set d = 0
        loop
            exitwhen d >= 16 or SubString(UJ_HEX, d, d + 1) == c
            set d = d + 1
        endloop
        exitwhen d >= 16
        set r = r * 16 + d
        set i = i + 1
    endloop
    return r
endfunction

function IntToRoman takes integer i returns string
    local string s = ""
    if i <= 0 or i >= 4000 then
        return ""
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i < 1000
        set s = s + "M"
        set i = i - 1000
    endloop
    if i >= 900 then
        set s = s + "CM"
        set i = i - 900
    elseif i >= 500 then
        set s = s + "D"
        set i = i - 500
    elseif i >= 400 then
        set s = s + "CD"
        set i = i - 400
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i < 100
        set s = s + "C"
        set i = i - 100
    endloop
    if i >= 90 then
        set s = s + "XC"
        set i = i - 90
    elseif i >= 50 then
        set s = s + "L"
        set i = i - 50
    elseif i >= 40 then
        set s = s + "XL"
        set i = i - 40
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i < 10
        set s = s + "X"
        set i = i - 10
    endloop
    if i == 9 then
        return s + "IX"
    elseif i >= 5 then
        set s = s + "V"
        set i = i - 5
    elseif i == 4 then
        return s + "IV"
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i < 1
        set s = s + "I"
        set i = i - 1
    endloop
    return s
endfunction

        return -MathRealFloor(-r + 0.5)

function MathRealLn takes real r returns real
    local integer k = 0
    local real z
    local real z2
    local real termo
    local real soma
    local integer n = 1
    if r <= 0 then
        return 0.0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen r < 2.0
        set r = r / 2.0
        set k = k + 1
    endloop
    loop
        exitwhen r >= 0.5
        set r = r * 2.0
        set k = k - 1
    endloop
    set z = (r - 1.0) / (r + 1.0)
    set z2 = z * z
    set termo = z
    set soma = 0.0
    loop
        exitwhen n > 41
        set soma = soma + termo / I2R(n)
        set termo = termo * z2
        set n = n + 2
    endloop
    return 2.0 * soma + I2R(k) * 0.6931471805599453
endfunction
```

`doctor/port/compat/part_13_hooks.j`:

```j
hashtable DB_ord_ht=null
boolean DB_ord_on=false
unit DB_gtu_u=null
integer DB_gtu_n=0
constant string DB_B36="0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

function DB_ord_init takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer k=32
    if DB_ord_on then
        return
    endif
    set DB_ord_on=true
    set DB_ord_ht=InitHashtable()
    call DB_chr_init()
    loop
        exitwhen k>126
        if (k<97 or k>122) and k!=47 then
            call SaveInteger(DB_ord_ht,0,StringHash(DB_CHR[k]),k)
        endif
        set k=k+1
    endloop
endfunction

function DB_ord takes string c returns integer
    local integer v
    local integer h
    if c==null or c=="" then
        return -1
    endif
    if c=="/" then
        return 47
    endif
    call DB_ord_init()
    set h=StringHash(c)
    if not HaveSavedInteger(DB_ord_ht,0,h) then
        return -1
    endif
    set v=LoadInteger(DB_ord_ht,0,h)
    if v>=65 and v<=90 and c!=StringCase(c,true) then
        return v+32
    endif
    return v
endfunction

function DB_chr takes integer b returns string
    if b<32 or b>126 then
        return ""
    endif
    call DB_chr_init()
    return DB_CHR[b]
endfunction

function DB_id2s takes integer a returns string
    local integer x
    local integer b3
    local integer b2
    local integer b1
    local integer b0
    if a==0 then
        return ""
    endif
    if a<0 then
        set x=a+2147483647+1
        set b3=x/16777216+128
        set x=x-(x/16777216)*16777216
    else
        set b3=a/16777216
        set x=a-b3*16777216
    endif
    set b2=x/65536
    set x=x-b2*65536
    set b1=x/256
    set b0=x-b1*256
    if b3>0 then
        return DB_chr(b3)+DB_chr(b2)+DB_chr(b1)+DB_chr(b0)
    elseif b2>0 then
        return DB_chr(b2)+DB_chr(b1)+DB_chr(b0)
    elseif b1>0 then
        return DB_chr(b1)+DB_chr(b0)
    endif
    return DB_chr(b0)
endfunction

function DB_s2id takes string s returns integer
    local integer n
    local integer i=0
    local integer r=0
    local integer v
    if s==null then
        return 0
    endif
    set n=StringLength(s)
    if n<1 or n>4 then
        return 0
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i>=n
        set v=DB_ord(SubString(s,i,i+1))
        if v<0 then
            return 0
        endif
        set r=r*256+v
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    return r
endfunction

function DB_gtu takes nothing returns unit
    if DB_gtu_n>0 then
        return DB_gtu_u
    endif
    return GetTriggerUnit()
endfunction

function DB_timer_decorrido takes timer t returns real
    return TimerGetTimeout(t)-TimerGetRemaining(t)
endfunction

function DB_lh_hotkey takes string s returns integer
    local integer t=0
    local integer i=0
    local integer k
    local string c
    if s==null or StringLength(s)!=3 then
        return GetLocalizedHotkey(s)
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i>=3
        set c=SubString(s,i,i+1)
        set k=0
        loop
            exitwhen k>=36
            if SubString(DB_B36,k,k+1)==c then
                exitwhen true
            endif
            set k=k+1
        endloop
        if k>=36 then
            set k=0
        endif
        set t=t*36+k
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    if t>=23328 then
        set t=t-46656
    endif
    return t
endfunction

function DB_lh_string takes string s returns string
    local integer n
    local integer i=0
    local integer k
    local string t=""
    if s==null or I2S(S2I(s))!=s then
        return GetLocalizedString(s)
    endif
    set n=S2I(s)
    set n=n-(n/46656)*46656
    if n<0 then
        set n=n+46656
    endif
    loop
        exitwhen i>=3
        set k=n/36
        set t=SubString(DB_B36,n-k*36,n-k*36+1)+t
        set n=k
        set i=i+1
    endloop
    return t
endfunction
```

```j
function DB_estado_max_vida takes unit u,real v returns nothing
    local real atual
    local real maxv
    local integer n
    //{{KK_SE:KK_EST_VIDA_GRANDE}}
    local real k
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_EST_VIDA_GRANDE}}
    if u==null then
        return
    endif
    if DB_est_diario_n>0 then
        call DB_est_diario_anota(u,-1,v)
    endif
    //{{KK_SE:KK_MORFO_ESTADO}}
    call DB_morfo_confere(u)
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_MORFO_ESTADO}}
    set atual=GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE)
    set maxv=GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
    set n=DB_est_arred(v)
    if n<1 then
        set n=1
    endif
    //{{KK_SE:KK_EST_VIDA_GRANDE}}
    if maxv>1000000.0 and I2R(n)*10.0<maxv then
        set k=maxv
        loop
            set k=k/10.0
            exitwhen k<=I2R(n)
            call BlzSetUnitMaxHP(u,R2I(k))
            call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,RMinBJ(GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE),k))
        endloop
    endif
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_EST_VIDA_GRANDE}}
    call BlzSetUnitMaxHP(u,n)
    if maxv>0.0 and atual>0.0 then
        if atual<v then
            call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,atual)
        else
            call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,v)
        endif
    endif
    //{{KK_SE:KK_MORFO_ESTADO}}
    call DB_morfo_refoto(u)
    //{{KK_FIMSE:KK_MORFO_ESTADO}}
endfunction

function DB_aspd_fator takes real v returns real
    if v<DB_ASPD_MIN then
        set v=DB_ASPD_MIN
    elseif v>DB_ASPD_MAX then
        set v=DB_ASPD_MAX
    endif
    return 1.0+v
endfunction

function DB_aspd_base takes unit u,integer h returns real
    local real c
    if HaveSavedReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL) then
        return LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL)
    endif
    set c=BlzGetUnitAttackCooldown(u,0)
    call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL,c)
    return c
endfunction

function DB_aspd_piso takes unit u returns real
    if DB_aspd_trg==null or u==null then
        return 0.0
    endif
    set DB_aspd_u=u
    set DB_aspd_piso_v=0.0
    call TriggerEvaluate(DB_aspd_trg)
    set DB_aspd_u=null
    return DB_aspd_piso_v
endfunction

function DB_aspd_aplica takes unit u,integer h returns nothing
    local real b=DB_aspd_base(u,h)
    local real c
    local real p
    local real d
    if b<=0.0 then
        return
    endif
    set c=b/DB_aspd_fator(LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_VEL))
    set p=DB_aspd_piso(u)
    if c<p then
        set c=p
    endif
    set d=BlzGetUnitAttackCooldown(u,0)-c
    if d>0.0005 or d<-0.0005 then
        call BlzSetUnitAttackCooldown(u,c,0)
    endif
endfunction

    set r=S2R(DB_slk_get(DB_TAB_UNIT,GetUnitTypeId(u),DB_C_UNIT_RANGEN1))

function DB_est_alcance_set takes unit u,integer h,real v returns nothing
    local real r0
    local real r1
    if DB_est_ataca(u) then
        set r0=BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_RANGE,0)
        if r0>0.0 then
            if v!=r0 then
                set r1=BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_RANGE,1)
                call BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_RANGE,1,v-r0+r1)
            endif
            call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_ALC,v)
            return
        endif
    endif
    set r0=DB_est_alcance(u,h)
    if v!=r0 then
        if not BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_RANGE,1,v-r0) then
            call BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_RANGE,0,v)
        endif
    endif
    call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_ALC,v)
endfunction

constant integer DB_EST_MORFO=10
constant integer DB_EST_F_DANO=11
constant integer DB_EST_F_DADOS=12
constant integer DB_EST_F_LADOS=13
constant integer DB_EST_F_ARMA=14
constant integer DB_EST_F_VIDA=15
constant integer DB_EST_F_MANA=16

constant integer DB_EST_F_PONTO=18
constant integer DB_EST_F_BACK=19

unit array DB_morfo_u

function DB_arma_foto takes unit u,integer h returns nothing
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_DANO,BlzGetUnitBaseDamage(u,0))
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_DADOS,BlzGetUnitDiceNumber(u,0))
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_LADOS,BlzGetUnitDiceSides(u,0))
    call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_ARMA,BlzGetUnitArmor(u))
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_VIDA,BlzGetUnitMaxHP(u))
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_MANA,BlzGetUnitMaxMana(u))
    if DB_est_ataca(u) then
        call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_ATQ,BlzGetUnitWeaponIntegerField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_IF_ATTACK_ATTACK_TYPE,0))
        call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_PONTO,BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_DAMAGE_POINT,0))
        call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_BACK,BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_BACKSWING_POINT,0))
        call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_VPROJ,BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_PROJECTILE_SPEED,0))
    endif
endfunction

function DB_arma_volta takes unit u,integer h,boolean mesmo returns nothing
    local integer i
    local real r
    set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_DANO)
    if BlzGetUnitBaseDamage(u,0)!=i then
        call BlzSetUnitBaseDamage(u,i,0)
    endif
    set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_DADOS)
    if i>0 and BlzGetUnitDiceNumber(u,0)!=i then
        call BlzSetUnitDiceNumber(u,i,0)
    endif
    set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_LADOS)
    if i>0 and BlzGetUnitDiceSides(u,0)!=i then
        call BlzSetUnitDiceSides(u,i,0)
    endif
    set r=LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_ARMA)
    if BlzGetUnitArmor(u)!=r then
        call BlzSetUnitArmor(u,r)
    endif
    set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_VIDA)
    if i>0 and BlzGetUnitMaxHP(u)!=i then
        call BlzSetUnitMaxHP(u,i)
    endif
    set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_MANA)
    if i>0 and BlzGetUnitMaxMana(u)!=i then
        call BlzSetUnitMaxMana(u,i)
    endif
    if DB_est_ataca(u) and HaveSavedReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_VPROJ) then
        set r=LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_VPROJ)
        if r>0.0 and BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_PROJECTILE_SPEED,0)<=0.0 then
            call BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_PROJECTILE_SPEED,0,r)
        endif
        if mesmo then
            set i=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_ATQ)
            if BlzGetUnitWeaponIntegerField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_IF_ATTACK_ATTACK_TYPE,0)!=i then
                call BlzSetUnitWeaponIntegerField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_IF_ATTACK_ATTACK_TYPE,0,i)
            endif
            set r=LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_PONTO)
            if BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_DAMAGE_POINT,0)!=r then
                call BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_DAMAGE_POINT,0,r)
            endif
            set r=LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_BACK)
            if BlzGetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_BACKSWING_POINT,0)!=r then
                call BlzSetUnitWeaponRealField(u,UNIT_WEAPON_RF_ATTACK_BACKSWING_POINT,0,r)
            endif
        endif
    endif
endfunction

function DB_morfo_volta takes unit u,integer h returns nothing
    local integer velho=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO)
    local integer novo=GetUnitTypeId(u)
    local real b
    local real c
    local real p
    call RemoveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO)
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_TIPO,novo)
    call DB_arma_volta(u,h,velho==novo)
    if HaveSavedReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL) then
        set b=LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL)
        set c=b/DB_aspd_fator(LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_VEL))
        set p=DB_aspd_piso(u)
        if c<p then
            set c=p
        endif
        set p=BlzGetUnitAttackCooldown(u,0)
        if velho!=novo and (p-c>0.0005 or c-p>0.0005) and not LoadBoolean(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL_MAPA) then
            call SaveReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_COOL,p)
        endif
        call DB_aspd_aplica(u,h)
    endif
    if velho!=novo and HaveSavedReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_ALC) then
        set b=S2R(DB_slk_get(DB_TAB_UNIT,velho,DB_C_UNIT_RANGEN1))
        set c=S2R(DB_slk_get(DB_TAB_UNIT,novo,DB_C_UNIT_RANGEN1))
        if b>0.0 and c>0.0 then
            call DB_est_alcance_set(u,h,LoadReal(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_ALC)-b+c)
        endif
    endif
endfunction

function DB_morfo_confere takes unit u returns nothing
    local integer h
    if DB_morfo_n==0 or u==null or DB_est_ht==null then
        return
    endif
    set h=GetHandleId(u)
    if HaveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) and GetUnitTypeId(u)!=0 and GetUnitTypeId(u)!=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
        call DB_morfo_volta(u,h)
    endif
endfunction

function DB_morfo_refoto takes unit u returns nothing
    local integer h
    if DB_morfo_n==0 or u==null or DB_est_ht==null then
        return
    endif
    set h=GetHandleId(u)
    if HaveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) and GetUnitTypeId(u)==LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
        call DB_arma_foto(u,h)
    endif
endfunction

function DB_morfo_tira takes integer i returns nothing
    set DB_morfo_n=DB_morfo_n-1
    set DB_morfo_u[i]=DB_morfo_u[DB_morfo_n]
    set DB_morfo_u[DB_morfo_n]=null
endfunction

function DB_morfo_tique takes nothing returns nothing
    local integer i=DB_morfo_n-1
    local unit u
    local integer h
    loop
        exitwhen i<0
        set u=DB_morfo_u[i]
        set h=GetHandleId(u)
        if GetUnitTypeId(u)==0 or not HaveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
            call RemoveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO)
            call DB_morfo_tira(i)
        elseif GetUnitTypeId(u)!=LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
            call DB_morfo_volta(u,h)
            call DB_morfo_tira(i)
        elseif LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_TIQUES)<=1 then
            call RemoveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO)
            call DB_morfo_tira(i)
        else
            call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_TIQUES,LoadInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_TIQUES)-1)
        endif
        set i=i-1
    endloop
    if DB_morfo_n==0 then
        call PauseTimer(DB_morfo_tmr)
    endif
    set u=null
endfunction

function DB_morfo_anuncia takes unit u returns nothing
    local integer h
    if u==null or GetUnitTypeId(u)==0 then
        return
    endif
    set h=DB_est_h(u)
    if not HaveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
        if DB_morfo_n>=DB_MORFO_MAX then
            return
        endif
        set DB_morfo_u[DB_morfo_n]=u
        set DB_morfo_n=DB_morfo_n+1
        if DB_morfo_tmr==null then
            set DB_morfo_tmr=CreateTimer()
        endif
        if DB_morfo_n==1 then
            call TimerStart(DB_morfo_tmr,0.05,true,function DB_morfo_tique)
        endif
    endif
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO,GetUnitTypeId(u))
    call SaveInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_F_TIQUES,40)
    call DB_arma_foto(u,h)
endfunction

function DB_morfo_skin_volta takes unit u returns nothing
    local integer h=GetHandleId(u)
    if DB_est_ht!=null and HaveSavedInteger(DB_est_ht,h,DB_EST_MORFO) then
        call DB_morfo_volta(u,h)
    endif
endfunction

function KK_morfo_antes takes unit u returns nothing
    call DB_morfo_anuncia(u)
endfunction

    if not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
        return 0.0
    endif
    set a=BlzGetUnitIntegerField(u,UNIT_IF_PRIMARY_ATTRIBUTE)
    if a==1 then
        return I2R(GetHeroStr(u,true))
    elseif a==2 then
        return I2R(GetHeroInt(u,true))
    elseif a==3 then
        return I2R(GetHeroAgi(u,true))
    endif
    return 0.0
endfunction
```
